title: Senior Australian Payroll & Employment Hero Implementation Specialist | Remote Contractor – Philippines
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Are you an experienced Australian payroll professional who knows Employment Hero Payroll beyond simply



We are an Australian payroll consulting and implementation business seeking a highly capable, Philippines-based contractor to support Australian clients with payroll processing, Employment Hero Payroll implementations, system configuration, testing and ongoing support.



This is a hands-on and client-facing position. You will work across multiple client payrolls and implementation projects and will be expected to identify issues, investigate discrepancies and take ownership of your work through to resolution.



This is not an entry-level, payroll administration or data-entry position. Strong Australian payroll knowledge and hands-on Employment Hero Payroll implementation experience are mandatory.



Experience with New Zealand payroll or Employment Hero HR implementations would be an added advantage but is not essential.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Australian payroll processing and support:



Process and review end-to-end Australian payrolls accurately and within required deadlines.

Review timesheets, employee changes, leave, allowances, deductions, superannuation and termination payments.

Complete payroll reconciliations, variance checks and payroll reporting.

Investigate discrepancies and resolve payroll processing or system configuration issues.

Respond professionally to client queries and clearly explain identified issues and required actions.

Identify and report payroll, compliance, data and system risks.

Maintain accurate records and protect confidential payroll information.

Manage work across multiple clients while meeting competing deadlines.



Employment Hero Payroll implementations:



Assist with and progressively manage Employment Hero Payroll implementations.

Gather, review and validate employee, payroll and historical data.

Configure businesses, pay schedules, pay categories, leave categories, allowances, deductions, superannuation and other payroll settings.

Configure and test pay rate templates, work types, rule sets, tags and employment conditions.

Assist with award and enterprise agreement configuration.

Prepare and validate employee uploads, opening balances and historical earnings data.

Support general ledger mapping and integrations with HR, accounting and time-and-attendance systems.

Perform system testing, user acceptance testing and parallel payroll comparisons.

Investigate and resolve variances identified during testing.

Prepare procedures, testing records, implementation documentation and client guides.

Assist with client training, handover and post-implementation support.



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE



You must have:



At least four to five years of hands-on Australian payroll experience.

Advanced practical knowledge of Employment Hero Payroll, formerly KeyPay.

Demonstrated Employment Hero Payroll implementation and configuration experience.

Experience processing Australian payroll from end to end—not only payroll administration or data entry.

Strong knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including Fair Work, modern awards, enterprise agreements, PAYG withholding, STP, superannuation, leave and termination payments.

Experience interpreting modern awards, enterprise agreements or other complex payroll conditions.

Strong reconciliation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.

Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate work.

The ability to work independently, manage priorities and meet strict deadlines.

A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection and a secure, private home workspace.



HIGHLY REGARDED



The following experience would be an advantage:



New Zealand payroll processing or implementation experience.

Employment Hero HR implementation or administration.

Managed or outsourced payroll experience across multiple clients.

Complex award and enterprise agreement rule configuration.

Payroll compliance reviews, audits or remediation calculations.

General ledger mapping and accounting-system integrations.

Preparing client guides, procedures and training materials.



ABOUT YOU



You are someone who:



Takes ownership of their work and follows issues through to resolution.

Understands that payroll accuracy requires investigation and professional judgement—not simply following a checklist.

Recognises incomplete or inconsistent information and asks questions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

Can work independently while keeping others informed of progress, issues and risks.

Is organised, dependable and comfortable managing several priorities.

Communicates professionally and confidently with clients.

Enjoys improving payroll systems, documentation and processes.

Is seeking a stable, long-term role where they can become a trusted member of the team.



CONTRACTOR ARRANGEMENT



This is a full-time remote independent contractor position based in the Philippines.



The engagement will initially be offered for three months. Our intention is to establish a long-term working relationship with the successful contractor, subject to demonstrated capability, reliability, performance and ongoing business requirements.



The contractor must be available during agreed working hours aligned with the Sydney business day and have the capacity to make this role their primary professional commitment.



The monthly contractor rate is PHP 80,000–95,000, depending on the depth of the applicant’s Australian payroll and Employment Hero implementation experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “EH IMPLEMENTATION” so we know you have read the advertisement carefully.



Please include your résumé and briefly answer the following questions:



How many years of hands-on Australian payroll experience do you have?

How long have you used Employment Hero Payroll or KeyPay?

How many Employment Hero Payroll implementations have you worked on, and which parts did you personally configure?

Briefly describe your experience with Australian modern awards, enterprise agreements or complex payroll rules.

Do you have any New Zealand payroll or Employment Hero HR implementation experience?

What is your availability to commence, and are you available to work full-time during hours aligned with the Sydney business day?



Please also confirm that the advertised monthly contractor range of PHP 80,000–95,000 is within your expectations.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and may be asked to complete a brief practical Australian payroll, Employment Hero configuration and Excel assessment. Reference checks may also be completed before an offer is made..

Earworx is a purpose and values-driven Australian healthcare business committed to delivering safe, professional and connected care. We are growing rapidly and are looking for a high-performing, proactive Virtual Assistant to help optimise our patient booking systems and marketing automation.

What Success Looks Like



· Consistent increase in bookings generated from marketing campaigns.

· Ongoing system improvements that increase efficiency and performance.

How to Apply

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Direct response video editor
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type:



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: Sr. Financial Planner Associate
description:
Description:

We are seeking a Senior Financial Planning Associate with expertise in paraplanning, SOA (Statement of Advice) preparation, and financial compliance. This role involves preparing SOAs using Plutosoft and AdviserLogic, supporting financial planners in research and analysis, and handling administrative and associate duties when not actively engaged in SOA preparation. The ideal candidate must be experienced in Australian financial planning regulations and capable of managing multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.



Qualifications:

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in Australian financial planning or a related field.

- Strong understanding of superannuation, SMSF, investment strategies, and financial compliance.

- Expertise in SOA preparation using Plutosoft and AdviserLogic.

- Proficiency in XPLAN, AdviserLogic, Salesforce, and financial modeling tools is a plus.

- Experience with Statement of Advice (SOA), compliance policies, and financial planning documentation.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, work under deadlines, and adapt to changing client needs.

- Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

- Excellent communication and organizational skills to support financial planners and clients.

- Experience handling complex financial planning tasks and client portfolios.



Responsibilities:

1. Client Communication & Consultation

a. Prepare comprehensive SOAs using Plutosoft and AdviserLogic in accordance with ASIC and AFSL regulations.

b. Conduct research on investment strategies, insurance products, superannuation options, and tax structures.

c. Ensure accuracy, compliance, and clarity in all SOAs before presenting them to clients.

d. Assist financial planners in gathering client information and setting financial goals.

e. Act as a liaison between clients, financial planners, and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth communication.

f. Schedule client meetings and respond to general inquiries related to financial planning.



2. Financial Data Analysis & Research

q. Analyze client financial data and create reports, charts, and models for planning decisions.

b. Conduct research on investment products, superannuation, insurance, and tax strategies to support advisors.

c. Assist in structuring financial plans aligned with clients' needs.



3. Compliance & Documentation

a. Ensure compliance with ASIC, AFSL, and other Australian financial regulations.

b. Assist in the preparation and organization of regulatory compliance forms, investment proposals, and financial plans.

c. Manage digital documentation and agreements using DocuSign.



4. Financial Planning Software & CRM Management

a. Utilize XPLAN, AdviserLogic, Salesforce, and financial modeling tools for client records and financial projections.

b. Maintain and update client data in Creatio CRM to streamline financial planning workflows.

c.  Support financial planners in optimizing CRM usage for client management.



5. Investment & Wealth Management Support

a. Provide insights on investment strategies, tax planning, and superannuation management.

b. Assist in managing Self-Managed Super Funds (SMSF) and other wealth-building strategies.

c. Monitor and update clients on their investment performance and market trends.



6. Administrative & Process Support

a. Handle administrative tasks such as client record maintenance, meeting scheduling, and correspondence.

b. Coordinate with accountants, tax advisors, and legal teams for a holistic financial planning approach.

c. Provide administrative assistance when not actively engaged in SOA preparation.

d. Assist with client onboarding, documentation processing, and appointment coordination.

e. Identify workflow improvements and contribute to process automation initiatives.

f. Required for creating financial projections and client reports.



7. Continuous Learning & Professional Growth

a. Stay updated on Australian financial regulations, taxation laws, and market trends.

b. Participate in training programs and professional development activities.

title: Financial Planning Practice Manger
description:
Description:

This is not a traditional practice manager role. Yes, you will own the day-to-day operations of a busy financial services practice, but you will also have a genuine mandate to rethink how we work. We are looking for someone who is as comfortable optimising a compliance workflow as they are experimenting with AI tools to reduce manual effort and increase team capacity.



Qualifications:

* 2+ years' experience in a Practice Manager, Senior Paraplanner, or Senior Financial Planning Assistant role within a financial planning practice.

* Strong working knowledge of Xplan (and ideally Worksorted/Marloo/RetireMap) and demonstrated ability to optimise platform usage.

* Genuine enthusiasm for technology and AI - you actively seek out tools that make work smarter, and you can bring a team along with you.

* Solid understanding of the Australian financial planning regulatory environment, including SOA/ROA preparation, FDS obligations, and AFSL compliance frameworks.

* Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities without dropping the ball.

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication - you interact with clients and external stakeholders directly.

* A proactive, ownership mindset - you see problems before they become issues, and you fix them.



Highly Regarded

* Hands-on experience implementing AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a professional services context.

* Exposure to SMSF and/or complex multi-strategy advice environments.

* Experience managing loan administration workflows end-to-end in a mortgage broking context.

* Experience in a multi-disciplinary firm (financial planning + mortgage broking).



Responsibilities:



Operations & Compliance

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the financial planning and mortgage broking practice, ensuring efficient and compliant service delivery.

* Oversee client onboarding, file management, and documentation to ensure accuracy and regulatory compliance across all advice and lending workflows.

* Oversee and be actively involved in the preparation, review, and finalised Statements of Advice (SOAs) and Records of Advice (ROAs), ensuring all documentation meets AFSL and regulatory standards.

* Ensure adherence to all licensing, compliance, and FDS/review obligations, and liaise with the AFSL and external compliance consultants as needed.

* Conduct monthly revenue reporting and KPI tracking to support strategic decision-making by the Principal.

* Supervise and support administrative and support staff, including workload management, training, and performance feedback.



Technology & Innovation

* Own the firm's technology stack - actively evaluate, implement, and optimise tools to improve efficiency and scalability across all service lines.

* Lead the integration and adoption of AI tools (e.g., Marloo etc) to automate repeatable tasks, improve document quality, and reduce manual effort across the advice and lending workflows.

* Administer and continuously improve our core platforms: Xplan, Worksorted, and Marloo, ensuring they are configured to support best practice workflows.

* Identify opportunities to automate client communications, data entry, compliance tracking, and reporting through integration of best-of-breed tools.

* Develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for key workflows, enabling consistent delivery as the team grows.

* Stay current with emerging fintech and AI developments relevant to financial planning and mortgage broking, and bring recommendations to the Principal.



Client & Business Development

* Liaise with clients in a professional and empathetic manner to support the delivery of a high-quality client experience.

* Assist with client engagement initiatives, marketing efforts, and new business workflows to support practice growth.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders including lenders, platform providers, software vendors, and product providers.

title: E-commerce & Social Media Virtual Assistant
description:
What this job is

Miçanga Swim is a small, growing swimwear brand in Los Angeles. Our founder designs everything, shoots all our content, runs our pop-ups, and manages production in Brazil. She has more good ideas than time to execute them.

That's where you come in. This is an execution role. You'll take a clear list of tasks and get them done consistently, week after week, without needing to be chased. If you're someone who likes checking things off and keeping a system running smoothly, you'll do well here.

You don't need to invent the plan. You need to run it.



What you'll actually do

Shopify store (about half your time)

Our store needs real work and we know exactly what it needs:

    •    Write and optimize product listings with SEO (titles, descriptions, tags, alt text)

    •    Build out size charts across every product

    •    Standardize product images so the store looks consistent

    •    Install and configure apps: size chart app, FAQ page, store locator,
 popup, shoppable Instagram feed, appointment booking

    •    Build out an FAQ page and a landing page

    •    Keep collections organized and seasonal

    •    Make sure every product is listed, complete, and live

    •    Process orders and update tracking

    •    Flag anything broken or off-brand

Social media (about a third of your time)

Our founder shoots great content. She goes viral regularly. The problem is consistency, and that's what you'll fix.

    •    Post 3 Instagram feed posts per week from content she provides

    •    Post 4 Instagram stories per week

    •    Post 3 TikToks per week

    •    Write captions in our brand voice

    •    Respond to DMs and comments on both platforms

    •    Light editing and cutting of clips she sends you

    •    Build simple graphics in Canva when we need them (sale announcements, size guides, story templates)

    •    Keep a running content calendar so we always know what's going out

    •    Join a short planning call every Sunday

Customer service and organization (the rest)

    •    Answer customer
s: sizing, shipping, returns, product questions

    •    Keep an organized file system for photos, videos, and product assets

    •    Name and sort content so we can actually find things later

    •    Keep a shared task list current and flag what needs the founder's decision

    •    Short weekly check-in on what got done and what's next



What we need from you

Required:

    •    Real hands-on Shopify experience. You've managed a store, not just seen one.

    •    Comfortable installing and configuring Shopify apps

    •    Solid written English. You'll be writing captions and talking to customers as our brand.

    •    Canva skills at a working level

    •    Experience scheduling and posting to Instagram and TikTok

    •    Organized. You keep files named and systems tidy without being told.

    •    Reliable. You do what you said you'd do, and you say something when you can't.

    •    Steady internet and clear communication

Helpful but not required:

    •    Fashion, swimwear, or lifestyle brand experience

    •    Basic photo or video editing (Lightroom, CapCut, or similar)

    •    Klaviyo or
 marketing experience

    •    Product photography editing and retouching

    •    Experience with a small brand where you wore a lot of hats



A normal week

    •    Optimize 5-8 product listings with SEO and size charts

    •    Install or configure an app we've asked for

    •    Post 3 IG feed posts, 4 stories, 3 TikToks

    •    Write the captions for all of it

    •    Answer 20-30 customer
s and DMs

    •    Make 2-3 Canva graphics

    •    Organize the week's new photos and video into the right folders

    •    Sunday planning call and a short Friday update on what shipped



First 30 days

    •    Every product listing has SEO, a complete description, and a size chart

    •    The core apps are installed and working

    •    Social is posting on schedule without the founder having to think about it

    •    Customer
s answered within 24 hours

    •    A file system exists and is being used

First 90 days

    •    Store is fully built out: FAQ, landing page, store locator, popup, IG feed

    •    Social has been consistent for three months straight

    •    You own customer service end to end

    •    The founder no longer thinks about posting, listings, or inbox



About Miçanga Swim

Miçanga Swim is an independent swimwear and activewear brand born between Los Angeles and Rio de Janeiro. We're inspired by the confidence, color, and effortless sexiness of Brazilian beach culture, combined with influences from founder Alena Slapak's Brazilian and Indian experiences.

Every piece is designed in small batches and produced in Brazil. Authentic Brazilian cuts with playful details, beading, and embroidery.

Community is the heart of what we do. We pop up almost every weekend at flea markets, vintage stores, and local events around Silver Lake and Echo Park, and we've built a loyal following across Los Angeles and San Diego through pop-ups, pool parties, wellness events, and customization experiences. We recently opened our first showroom in Downtown LA.

Most of our sales have come from meeting people in person. Our next chapter is bringing that same energy online, and that's the job you'd be helping with.

At its core Miçanga is about great bikinis, self-expression, and building a community people actually want to be part of.



Why this role exists

Our founder does design, production, photography, pop-ups, and travels to Brazil to manage manufacturing. The online side keeps getting pushed to whenever she has a spare hour, which means it moves slowly.

We want someone to own it so it stops depending on her. If you do this well, you'll see the store grow and you'll have had a direct hand in it.



How to apply

Send us:

    1    A short note about why this role interests you

    2    Links to two or three Shopify stores you've worked on, and what you did on them

    3    An example of social media you've managed

    4    Your rate, your weekly availability, and your time zone

    5    One thing you'd change about our site after looking at 

That last one matters most. We want to see how you think.

title: Google & YouTube Ads Specialist (Ecommerce Brand)
description:
Are YOU an experienced Google Ads specialist who knows how to build a Search Brand Protection campaign that actually stops competitors and resellers from hijacking your branded traffic? Can you look at a broken conversion tracking setup and immediately spot where the pixel is leaking data? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.



We run Sashiko, an international ecommerce brand, and we're looking for a Google Ads Specialist to take ownership of our Search and YouTube advertising.



We need someone to take responsibility for:



Search Brand Protection, Done Right: We already launched a Brand Protection Search campaign ourselves and it did not work. You will audit what went wrong (keyword selection, match types, negative keywords, competitor bidding on our brand terms) and rebuild it into a campaign that actually defends our branded traffic.



YouTube Ads, From Zero: We have never run YouTube Ads. You will plan, structure, and launch our first YouTube campaigns — audience targeting, ad formats, creative testing cadence — and own their ongoing optimization.



Performance Max Evaluation: Assess whether PMax is a fit for our catalog and goals, and if so, structure and launch it correctly (asset groups, signals, exclusions) rather than treating it as a "set and forget" black box.



Tracking & Pixel Audit: We suspect our tracking has gaps. You will audit our Google Ads conversion tracking, GA4 setup, and pixel implementation, identify where data is being lost or misattributed, and fix it.



Weekly Performance Review: A short weekly check-in to walk us through results, what changed, and what's next. This is not a "launch and disappear" engagement — we want to actually see the numbers move.



Position Requirements:



At least 2-3 years of specific experience running Google Ads and YouTube Ads for ecommerce brands. You must be able to show real account results, not just certifications.



Strong technical grounding in tracking: comfortable diagnosing conversion tracking issues, GA4 configuration, and pixel/tag implementation problems — this is a recurring pain point for us and a core reason we're hiring.



Hands-on Search campaign expertise, specifically keyword strategy for brand protection / defensive campaigns — this is not generic "grow your Search account" work.



Judgment on PMax, not blind enthusiasm for it: we want someone who can tell us honestly whether it's the right tool for a given goal.



Clear, proactive communication: you flag problems and propose fixes without needing to be chased.



Availability: This is a part-time, ongoing collaboration — a few hours per week for campaign management and one weekly review call. This is not a full-time role, but we are looking for someone reliable who stays engaged month over month, not a one-off project.



What We Offer:



Ongoing Retainer: Paid hourly / weekly retainer based on the scope above, with room to grow as budgets and campaigns expand.



Real Ownership: You will own Search and YouTube end-to-end for the brand — not just execute someone else's brief.



Results-Focused Relationship: We care about outcomes. If the numbers move in the right direction, this can become a long-term, expanding engagement.

title: Accounting, Accounts Receivable & Collections Virtual Assistant – Remote
description:
Company: Swift Appliances

Type of Work: Part-Time

Hours: Approximately 20 hours/week

Salary: $4–$6 USD/hour

Schedule: Must have availability during Canadian Eastern Time (ET) business hours



ABOUT THE POSITION



Swift Appliances is a Canadian appliance installation, repair, and service company.



We are looking for a reliable, professional, and detail-oriented Accounts Receivable & Collections Virtual Assistant to join our team.



Your primary responsibility will be to make sure outstanding invoices are followed up on consistently and professionally.



This is not simply a data-entry position. We need someone who is comfortable
ing and calling customers regarding outstanding balances and following up until payment is received or the account needs to be escalated.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Accounts Receivable & Collections



* Review outstanding Accounts Receivable regularly.

* Monitor current, 30-day, 60-day and 90+ day accounts.

* Contact customers regarding outstanding invoices.

* Follow up by telephone and
.

* Send invoices, account statements and payment reminders.

* Follow up on promised payment dates.

* Maintain detailed notes of every collection attempt.

* Respond professionally to customer payment questions.

* Identify disputed invoices or discrepancies.

* Escalate problem accounts to management when necessary.

* Provide management with a weekly A/R aging and collections report.



Accounting & Administration



* Record and track customer payments.

* Match payments against outstanding invoices.

* Assist with customer account reconciliations.

* Identify missing payments, credits, duplicate invoices and discrepancies.

* Maintain accurate customer account information.

* Maintain Excel/Google Sheets tracking reports.

* Assist with QuickBooks Online.

* Maintain organized records of customer communications.



REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Previous Accounts Receivable, collections, bookkeeping or accounting experience.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confidence speaking with Canadian customers over the telephone.

* Professional telephone manner.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Good Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

* Basic understanding of accounting and account reconciliation.

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

* Ability to follow up consistently without needing to be reminded.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Reliable computer and headset.

* Quiet environment suitable for customer calls.



Preferred



* QuickBooks Online experience.

* Previous North American A/R or collections experience.

* Experience with construction, property management, trades or service companies.

* Experience dealing with commercial customer accounts.



WORKING HOURS



This position will start at approximately 20 hours per week.



Because you will be contacting Canadian customers, you must be available for a portion of Monday–Friday Canadian Eastern Time business hours.



There is potential for additional hours and responsibilities for the right person.



COMPENSATION



$4–$6 USD/hour depending on experience and qualifications.



We are looking for a long-term team member. Compensation may be reviewed based on performance, reliability and results.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Start your application with the words:



SWIFT AR



Then provide the following:



1. Your full name and location.

2. Your resume.

3. How many years of Accounts Receivable or collections experience you have.

4. Describe your previous A/R and collections responsibilities.

5. Tell us about your experience with QuickBooks Online.

6. Tell us about your experience with Excel or Google Sheets.

7. Have you previously called customers regarding overdue invoices? Please explain.

8. Have you worked with Canadian or U.S. customers?

9. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

10. How many hours per week are you available?

11. Are you currently working for another employer or client?

12. What hours are you available in Eastern Time (ET)?

13. How soon can you start?



REQUIRED ENGLISH VOICE RECORDING



Please include a 60–90 second voice recording in English.



In the recording:

title: Customer Service, Scheduling & Appliance Parts Virtual Assistant – Remote
description:
Customer Service, Scheduling & Appliance Parts Virtual Assistant – Remote



Company: Swift Appliances

Type: Part-Time / Potential Full-Time

Starting Hours: Approximately 20–30 hours/week

Compensation: $4–$6 USD/hour

Schedule: Canadian Eastern Time (ET)



ABOUT THE POSITION



Swift Appliances is a Canadian appliance installation, repair, and service company.



We are looking for an organized, resourceful and customer-focused Virtual Assistant to help our team with:



* Booking and coordinating service appointments

* Customer follow-ups

* Online review follow-ups

* Appliance parts research

* General customer service and administrative support



This position requires excellent English, strong internet research skills, attention to detail and confidence communicating with customers.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Appointment Scheduling & Customer Service



* Contact customers by phone, text and
.

* Book appliance repair and installation appointments.

* Confirm appointments with customers.

* Reschedule appointments when necessary.

* Coordinate technician availability with customer availability.

* Collect customer information, including:

    * Name

    * Address

    * Phone number

    *

    * Appliance type

    * Brand

    * Model number

    * Description of problem

* Update appointment information accurately.

* Follow up with customers after service.

* Respond to basic customer inquiries.

* Escalate technical or sensitive customer issues to management.



Customer Follow-Up & Online Reviews



* Follow up with customers after completed appointments.

* Confirm that customers are satisfied with the service.

* Send customers our Google review link.

* Politely encourage satisfied customers to leave a review.

* Monitor incoming reviews.

* Prepare professional responses to customer reviews.

* Identify negative reviews or dissatisfied customers and immediately escalate them to management.

* Maintain a record of customers contacted for reviews.



Appliance Parts Research



A major part of this position will be helping our technicians locate appliance parts.



You will:



* Research appliance parts using brand and model numbers.

* Find manufacturer parts diagrams and exploded views.

* Identify correct OEM part numbers.

* Search Canadian and U.S. appliance-parts suppliers.

* Compare prices between suppliers.

* Check availability and estimated delivery times.

* Find discontinued-part replacements or superseded part numbers.

* Identify compatible alternatives when appropriate.

* Provide links and supplier information to management.

* Maintain organized records of parts researched and ordered.



Accuracy is extremely important.



Never assume that a part is compatible simply because it looks similar. Part numbers and model compatibility must be verified before recommending a part.



Administrative Support



* Maintain customer records.

* Update spreadsheets and internal systems.

* Organize service information.

* Follow up on outstanding customer requests.

* Assist management and technicians with online research.

* Perform other customer-service and administrative duties as required.



REQUIREMENTS



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Professional telephone manner.

* Previous customer-service, call-centre, dispatch, scheduling or Virtual Assistant experience.

* Excellent internet research skills.

* Comfortable working with Google.

* Strong computer skills.

* Excel and/or Google Sheets experience.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Able to manage several customer requests simultaneously.

* Strong organizational skills.

* Resourceful and able to solve problems independently.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Reliable computer and headset.

* Quiet environment for customer calls.

* Available during Canadian Eastern Time business hours.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is an advantage:



* Appliance repair/service companies

* HVAC, plumbing or electrical service companies

* Field-service businesses

* Service scheduling or dispatch

* Appliance parts

* Parts diagrams

* Manufacturer websites

* Google Business Profile / Google Reviews

* Canadian or U.S. customers



Previous appliance experience is NOT mandatory if you are an excellent researcher and willing to learn.



COMPENSATION



$4–$6 USD/hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



The position will initially be approximately 20–30 hours per week, with the possibility of becoming a full-time position.



Performance and compensation may be reviewed as responsibilities increase.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read the entire posting before applying.



Start your application with:



SWIFT SERVICE



Applications that do not include these words may not be considered.



Please provide:



1. Full name and location.

2. Resume.

3. Customer-service experience.

4. Appointment scheduling or dispatch experience.

5. Experience speaking with Canadian or U.S. customers.

6. Experience researching products or parts online.

7. Experience with Google Reviews or customer review follow-ups.

8. Current employment status.

9. Expected hourly rate in USD.

10. Hours available per week.

11. Availability in Canadian Eastern Time.

12. Earliest available start date.



REQUIRED VOICE RECORDING



Include a 60–90 second English voice recording.



Please introduce yourself and explain your customer-service experience and why you would be suitable for this position.



Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared script.



APPLICATION TEST



Please answer these three questions in your own words:



1. Scheduling



A customer needs a dishwasher repair. The technician has availability between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM tomorrow. Explain how you would communicate this appointment window to the customer.



2. Customer Review



A technician completed a repair yesterday and the customer was very happy with the service. Explain how you would follow up and ask them for a Google review.



3. Parts Research



A technician tells you:



“I need the drain pump for a Whirlpool dishwasher, model WDT730HAMZ.”



Explain step-by-step how you would find the correct part.



Do not simply provide a part number. We want to understand how you research and verify information.



HIRING PROCESS



Step 1: Application review

Step 2: English voice recording review

Step 3: Research and scheduling test

Step 4: Video interview

Step 5: Final selection



We are looking for someone who is friendly, organized, resourceful, accurate and dependable and who wants a long-term position with our company.

title: Media & E-Commerce Coordinator
description:
We're Five Star Napkins, the luxury organic cotton napkin trusted by Michelin-starred restaurants, five-star hotels, and Forbes Travel Guide establishments worldwide.



We're looking for a curious, self-sufficient Media & E-Commerce Coordinator to own the research and content engine behind our marketing calendar. This is not a media buying role, you won't be touching ad accounts or campaign spend. Instead, you'll be the person constantly watching what's happening in creative trends, events, hospitality, and pop culture, and turning that into ideas, content, and a well-organized
 calendar our team can act on.



This role exists to keep us plugged into what's happening in the world and consistently producing organic content, so our senior team can focus on strategy instead of chasing trends and building calendars from scratch.







What You'll Do



Primary: Trend & Cultural Research



Track current trends across creative formats, hospitality, events, and pop culture, specifically anything relevant to luxury, gifting, celebrations, and entertaining

Watch for viral moments, seasonal hooks, and cultural events (major holidays, milestone occasions, hospitality industry happenings) that we could tie creative or campaigns to

Bring these findings back to the team regularly as concrete ideas, not just a list of links





Primary: Organic Content Creation



Create organic content (short-form video, social posts) based on the trends and ideas you're researching

Turn scripts, references, and creative direction into finished content using simple editing tools (CapCut, Canva, or equivalent)

Help build toward a consistent, repeatable organic posting cadence across our social channels





Secondary: General Support (Based on Capacity)



Assist with organizing assets, briefs, and creative files so the wider team can move quickly

Support ad hoc marketing and content tasks as they come up





What You Already Know (Non-Negotiables):



You're genuinely plugged into culture, you notice trends before they're mainstream, and you can explain why something is working

You're organized and detail-oriented, a calendar you own stays accurate and current, nothing falls through the cracks

You have a good eye for content and can turn a simple brief into a finished short-form video

You're naturally curious and proactive, you bring ideas to the table rather than waiting to be told what to look for

You can take direction, run with a process, and flag when something needs a decision above your level

Required Skills

1 to 3+ years of experience in a content, social media, marketing coordination, or e-commerce support role

Working knowledge of Klaviyo or a similar
 platform (calendar/scheduling experience, campaign build experience is a bonus)

Basic video editing ability using tools like CapCut, Canva, or similar

Strong research skills, able to spot and summarize trends clearly and quickly

Reliable, self-directed, and comfortable working async with a remote team across time zones

Strong written English communication for reporting, trend summaries, and day-to-day coordination with the team

title: Experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter – Business Funding | Base + Commission
description:
PillarStar Capital is a growing U.S. business-funding company looking for an experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter to join our team.



This is not an entry-level cold-calling position.



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands Merchant Cash Advance (MCA), alternative business funding, and how to speak confidently with U.S. business owners.



Your primary goal is to turn leads into qualified merchants with completed applications and bank statements.



You will work leads provided by PillarStar and move merchants through:



Lead → Conversation → Interest → Qualification → Application/Bank Statements → Complete Package



Our processing and closing team will handle the later stages of the transaction.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners.

Speak with owners and decision makers.

Identify current or future business-funding needs.

Determine requested funding amount and use of funds.

Ask about monthly business revenue.

Identify existing MCA positions and payments.

Qualify merchants according to PillarStar guidelines.

Request applications and recent business bank statements.

Handle common merchant objections professionally.

Follow up aggressively but professionally with interested merchants.

Re-engage previous leads.

Maintain accurate CRM notes and follow-up dates.

Work closely with processing and closing staff.

Help consistently generate complete funding packages, not just calls.

Who We Are Looking For



2+ years of direct MCA/business-funding experience is strongly preferred.



You should already understand terms such as:



First position

Second position

Stacking

Daily/weekly payments

Bank statements

Revenue qualification

Funding applications



You should also have:



Strong spoken English.

Clear, confident phone presence.

Experience calling U.S. business owners.

Strong objection-handling skills.

Experience asking merchants for applications and bank statements.

CRM and outbound-dialer experience.

Strong follow-up discipline.

Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

Backup internet/power.

Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Compensation



Starting rate: $4.00/hour



Strong candidates with verifiable MCA experience may start higher, up to $5.00/hour.



There will be a 30-day performance review, with opportunities for increases based on results.



You will also earn:



5% of PillarStar Capital's commission actually collected on funded transactions originating from your assigned leads.



Commission is earned only after the transaction funds and PillarStar receives its commission.



As the company grows, strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation, bonuses, senior sales responsibilities, and advancement into closing roles.



How Performance Is Measured



We care about results, not meaningless dialing.



We measure:



Calls → Merchant Conversations → Interested Merchants → Applications/Statements Requested → Complete Packages → Funded Deals



We also measure call quality, attendance, follow-up, CRM accuracy, professionalism, and package quality.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



PILLARSTAR MCA – [Your Name] – [Years of MCA Experience]



Please submit:



1. Your resume



2. A REQUIRED 60–90 second voice sample



In your normal speaking voice:



Introduce yourself.

Tell us how many years of MCA/business-funding experience you have.

Give us a 20–30 second example of how you would open a call with a U.S. business owner.

Then answer this merchant objection:



“I'm not sending you my bank statements until you tell me what rate you're offering.”



Do not submit an AI-generated voice.



Answer These 7 Questions

How many years have you worked specifically in MCA or alternative business funding? What were your roles?

In your most recent MCA role, approximately how many complete applications + bank-statement packages did you personally generate per week?

Approximately how many funded transactions per month originated from your opportunities, if your company tracked this?

Explain the difference between a first-position MCA, second-position MCA, and stacking.

Write exactly what you would say if a merchant tells you:

“I'm not sending statements until you tell me the rate.”

Which MCA CRMs, dialers, or sales platforms have you previously used?

What hourly rate are you currently seeking, and are you available Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern business hours?



Qualified candidates will be invited to a short interview and live MCA merchant role-play.

title: Compliance Coordinator
description:
TSGBH is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Compliance Coordinator to support our behavioral health operations.



This position will help ensure that required documentation, employee files, client records, credentialing information, training requirements, and internal compliance processes are completed accurately and on time.



This is not simply an administrative assistant position. We need someone who can review records, identify missing or expired items, follow up with staff, maintain compliance trackers, and escalate concerns before they become larger problems.



Key Responsibilities



* Review employee and contractor files for required documentation

* Monitor expiration dates for licenses, credentials, certifications, trainings, and other required documents

* Maintain compliance tracking spreadsheets and internal systems

* Review client records for missing or incomplete documentation

* Monitor required signatures, assessments, treatment documents, and administrative forms

* Follow up with employees regarding missing or overdue compliance items

* Track onboarding and annual compliance requirements

* Assist with employee credentialing and recredentialing documentation

* Assist with payer and provider enrollment documentation as assigned

* Organize documents for internal and external audits

* Conduct routine file audits using established checklists

* Document compliance findings and corrective actions

* Monitor deadlines and send reminders before items become overdue

* Maintain organized electronic compliance files

* Assist management with policy and procedure tracking

* Review records for consistency with company requirements

* Report significant compliance concerns to management

* Assist with corrective action follow-up

* Protect confidential information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:



* Healthcare compliance

* Behavioral health administration

* Medical records

* Credentialing

* Human resources compliance

* Quality assurance

* Healthcare documentation

* Medicaid provider operations

* HIPAA-related administrative work



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare or behavioral health organization** is a major advantage.



Skills Needed



The successful candidate must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Highly organized

* Comfortable reviewing large amounts of documentation

* Able to identify missing, incomplete, or expired information

* Comfortable following up repeatedly when required

* Able to maintain accurate tracking systems

* Able to meet deadlines without constant supervision

* Comfortable communicating professionally with employees and management

* Able to protect confidential information

* Comfortable learning new systems and processes

* Strong in written English

* Reliable and consistent with attendance



 What Success Looks Like



We do not want someone who simply checks boxes.



We need someone who asks:



**What is missing?

What is expiring soon?

Who is responsible for correcting it?

Has the issue been resolved?

What creates a risk for the organization?

What needs to be escalated to management?**



The goal of this position is to help prevent compliance problems before they become audit findings, payment issues, employee credentialing problems, or operational risks.



Daily Compliance Expectations



The Compliance Specialist should maintain a clear record of:



* Items reviewed

* Deficiencies identified

* Employees or departments contacted

* Items corrected

* Items still outstanding

* Upcoming expiration dates

* Issues requiring management attention



Every compliance issue should have a clear status and next action.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate.



Employees who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, accuracy, independent problem-solving, and the ability to manage compliance responsibilities with limited supervision may be considered for future compensation reviews and expanded responsibilities.



Schedule



Candidates must be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Reliable internet, a dependable computer, and a quiet professional workspace are required.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe any experience you have with healthcare, compliance, credentialing, medical records, or quality assurance.

title: Billing & Claims Specialist
description:
TSGBH is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented  Billing & Claims Specialist to support our behavioral health billing operations.



This position is ideal for someone who has experience working with  U.S. healthcare claims, insurance billing, Medicaid, claim follow-up, and payment reconciliation .



Your primary responsibility will be making sure services that have been provided are properly billed, claims are followed through to payment, and billing problems are identified and resolved quickly.



This is  not simply a data-entry position.  We need someone who can review a claim, identify why it has not been paid, and take the appropriate next step.



Key Responsibilities



* Submit and monitor insurance claims

* Review claims for accuracy before submission

* Track unpaid, pending, rejected, and denied claims

* Follow up with insurance companies and managed care organizations regarding claim status

* Review EOBs, ERAs, and payment information

* Identify claim denials and rejection reasons

* Correct and resubmit rejected or denied claims when appropriate

* Maintain an organized list of outstanding claims

* Post or reconcile insurance payments as assigned

* Verify that services documented have been billed

* Identify missing documentation that may prevent billing

* Identify authorization or eligibility problems affecting claims

* Communicate billing issues to management and clinical/administrative staff

* Maintain accurate notes regarding claim follow-up activity

* Assist with accounts receivable and aging reports

* Escalate claims that require additional intervention

* Protect confidential patient information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Healthcare billing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand or have experience with:



* U.S. healthcare insurance billing

* Behavioral health or mental health billing

* Medicaid claims

* CMS-1500/professional claims

* Claims submission

* Denials and rejections

* EOBs and ERAs

* Accounts receivable

* Insurance eligibility

* Prior authorizations

* Claim status follow-up

* Payment reconciliation





Skills Needed



The right person must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching billing problems

* Able to follow a claim from submission through payment

* Comfortable communicating professionally by
 and telephone

* Able to document their work clearly

* Able to recognize when something does not look correct

* Reliable and consistent with attendance

* Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time hours



Strong written English and professional communication skills are required.



Performance Expectations



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the billing process.



You should not simply report that a claim was denied.



We expect you to determine:



Why was it denied?

Can it be corrected?

What information is missing?

Who needs to take action?

What is the next step?



Our goal is to maintain clean claims, reduce denials, follow up aggressively on outstanding balances, and make sure the company receives payment for services that have been properly provided.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour with Bonus



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate. Performance, reliability, accuracy, and demonstrated ability to manage claims independently will be considered during future compensation reviews.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe your previous U.S. healthcare billing experience.

3. What types of insurance or Medicaid claims have you worked with?

4. Have you worked with behavioral health or mental health billing?

5. What billing or EHR systems have you used?

6. Describe how you would handle a claim that was submitted but has not been paid after 30 days.

7. Describe a denial you have handled in the past and how you resolved it.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during **U.S. Eastern Time**.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who wants to learn our organization, take ownership of our claims, and become a dependable long-term member of our administrative team.

title: Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description:
About us

We are a Sydney-based digital marketing agency. We run SEO, Google Ads, content and AI-search visibility programs for Australian e-commerce and B2B businesses, including two of the country's larger online commercial kitchen equipment retailers, a stone-slab manufacturer and a gaming-peripherals store.

We are a small team that works closely with automation. A lot of our on-page, content and reporting work is systemised, and it is producing rankings. Our off-page authority is now the ceiling. We have tried bulk link vendors and mass outreach and neither earned links that matter. We want a person who knows how real links get earned in a market like Australia and can build that capability properly.

The role

You will own link acquisition across our client portfolio and our own agency site. That means finding the sites that are realistically going to link to a commercial kitchen equipment retailer or a stone manufacturer, working out what those sites need from us, making the approach, following it through, and proving the link is live and worth having.

You will not be sending templated
s to a scraped list. We have automation for volume already. Your value is the judgement in front of it: qualifying prospects, choosing the angle, building relationships with editors and trade bodies, vetting any paid placement so we never buy spam again, and turning client assets into things people want to cite.

About 50% of the time is prospecting and qualification, 30% is outreach and relationship follow-up, and 20% is linkable-asset planning, vetting and reporting.

What you will do

Prospecting and qualification

Build and maintain a prospect bank per client: trade publications, industry associations, supplier and manufacturer partner pages, Australian business directories that carry weight, local media, complementary businesses, and resource pages that already link to competitors.

Qualify every prospect on whether it actually links out to businesses like ours, not just whether the topic matches. Check outbound link patterns, editorial standards and freshness before anyone spends time on it.

Reverse-engineer competitor backlink profiles and separate the links we can realistically replicate from the ones we cannot.

Score and document prospects in our shared tracker so the outreach pipeline has clean targets to work with.

Outreach and relationships

Write personalised approaches to editors, association staff, suppliers and business owners. Each one cites something specific about their site and offers something they want: data, an expert quote, a product for review, a partner listing, a fix for a broken link.

Run follow-up sequences and keep a live record of every conversation, status and next action.

Work with our automated outreach pipeline: you set the targets and angles, review and approve drafts, and feed back what wins and what fails so the pipeline gets smarter.

Handle supplier and partner links directly: many of our clients' brands have "where to buy" or dealer pages we are not on yet.

Linkable assets and digital PR

Identify what each client could publish that would earn citations: buying guides, Australian benchmark data, compliance explainers, calculators, original photography. Brief our content team on what to make and why it will get linked.

Pitch client expertise to Australian media and journalist-request services (SourceBottle, Qwoted and similar) for expert quotes and mentions.

Coordinate press-style placements around client news, product launches and case studies.

Vetting, quality control and reporting

Vet any proposed paid placement or guest post site before purchase: real traffic, real editorial, no PBN or web 2.0 footprint, relevant to the client, not selling links to everyone. Recommend or reject with reasons. Andy approves spend.

Verify each acquired link is live, indexed, dofollow where agreed, and pointing at the correct URL. Re-check at 30 and 90 days and chase removals.

Maintain a monthly report per client: new referring domains, quality tier of each, target pages linked, what was pitched and the response rate, what is in progress.

Flag anything that looks like a toxic-link risk and recommend whether a disavow is warranted.

What we need from you

Must-haves

2+ years of hands-on link building or digital PR outreach where you personally earned links from real editorial sites. You can show examples and explain how each one happened.

You understand the difference between a link that moves rankings and a link that is just a number. You can spot a PBN, a web 2.0 network or a link farm in a few minutes and explain what gives it away.

Excellent written English. Your outreach
s are short, specific and human, and you can adjust tone from a trade editor to a small-business owner.

Comfortable with SEO tooling: backlink analysis (SE Ranking, Ahrefs, Semrush or Majestic),
 finding and verification, Google Search Console, and spreadsheets as your working tracker.

Organised and persistent. Outreach is a pipeline of many small follow-ups over weeks, and you keep every thread alive without being told.

Honest reporting. You tell us when a month was weak and why. We would rather hear "zero links, here is what I learned" than see inflated numbers.

Nice-to-haves

Experience in the Australian, UK or US market, or with B2B and trade industries rather than lifestyle niches.

Digital PR experience: journalist requests, data-led stories, expert commentary placements.

Experience with e-commerce clients, where the link targets are category and product pages rather than blog posts.

Familiarity with outreach automation platforms such as Smartlead, Pitchbox, BuzzStream or Respona.

Basic content brief writing, so you can tell a writer exactly what a linkable asset needs to contain.

Not a fit if

Your experience is mainly buying guest posts from marketplaces or running "DA 50+ guaranteed" packages.

You measure success in link count rather than referring-domain quality and target-page impact.

Working arrangements

Full-time, 40 hours per week, flexible schedule with at least 5 hours overlapping 9am–5pm Sydney time. Australian public holidays are observed.

Remote from home. You supply your own computer and internet; we provide all software and tool seats.

Paid twice monthly via Wise or a payroll platform. 13th-month pay included. Paid leave after a 3-month probation period.

You will work directly with the founder and with our automated systems. There is a lot of room to shape how this function runs.

Regular pay reviews tied to results and responsibility.

How to apply

Reply with the following. Applications that skip any item will not be considered.

Your CV and your OnlineJobs.ph profile link (or LinkedIn), including English test results if you have them.

Three links you personally earned for a previous employer or client. For each one: the linking page URL, the target page, how the placement happened, and roughly how long it took. Paid placements are fine to include if you say so.

Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date.

Written answers to these three questions:

Q1. Our client sells commercial ovens and commercial fridges to Australian restaurants and cafes online. List 8 realistic types of website or organisation that might link to their category pages, and for each one say in a sentence what we would offer them so they say yes.

Q2. A vendor offers 200 backlinks for AUD 150, or a "DA 55 guest post" for AUD 60. Write the 5 checks you would run before recommending either, and what result on each check would make you say no.

Q3. Paste one real outreach
 you have sent that won a link. Names and domains can be blurred. Then tell us in two sentences why you think it worked.

Start your application with the word ANCHOR so we know you read the full post.

title: Creative Strategist
description:

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.
