description:
YouTube Video Editor + Channel Assistant Long-Term



Workload: 4 long-form videos + approximately 12–24 Shorts per month

Additional responsibilities: Thumbnails + YouTube uploading & scheduling

Start: As soon as possible

Budget: $350–500 USD/month depending on experience

Turnaround: Ideally 3–5 business days per long-form video

Tools: Descript + CapCut



About the Channel



I run FeminaFlow, a YouTube channel and coaching business focused on nervous system regulation, somatic work, breathwork, self-discovery and creating a life beyond survival mode.



My content is intimate, deep and educational.



You'll primarily be working with two types of long-form content:



* Talking-head educational videos

* Guided somatic / breathwork practices



My visual direction is cinematic, feminine and natural, almost like a frame from a documentary.



I am not looking for hyper-edited YouTube content.



No constant zooms.

No unnecessary sound effects.

No flashy transitions every few seconds.

No turning a 20-minute conversation into TikTok.



The editing should support the message rather than compete with it.



I'm looking for one person who can become my long-term YouTube editing partner and gradually take the production side of the channel off my hands.



The goal is for our workflow to become:



I create & record → send you the footage → review the draft → you take care of everything else until publication.



----



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Long-Form Videos — 4/month



You'll edit a mix of talking-head educational videos and guided somatic/breathwork practices.



Most videos will be approximately 5–30 minutes.



This includes:



* Clean cuts and natural pacing

* Removing mistakes, repetitions and unnecessary pauses

* Preserving intentional pauses and emotional moments

* Basic audio cleanup and leveling

* Basic color correction

* Light B-roll when it genuinely adds something

* Simple, tasteful text where appropriate

* Maintaining a consistent FeminaFlow visual style

* Final high-quality export



2. Shorts — Approximately 12–24/month



Short-form content will come from two sources.



- Repurposed Shorts



The goal is approximately 12 repurposed Shorts per month where the long-form footage allows for it.



You'll:



* Extract the best section that will be pointed by me

* Create a compelling opening where necessary

* Format the footage vertically

* Add clean captions

* Tighten the pacing while keeping my natural speaking style

* Preserve the original meaning and context



Also, I don't want clips created simply to hit a quota.



I want someone who can recognize:



“This 45 seconds deserves to become its own piece of content.”



- Original Shorts



I may also record up to 12 additional Shorts per month specifically for short-form.



These will already be conceived and recorded as standalone pieces, so you won't need to find the content within a longer video.



They will primarily require:



* Clean editing

* Captions

* Basic visual formatting

* Audio/color adjustments where needed

* Final vertical export



Depending on the month, total Short volume will therefore typically be around 12–24 Shorts.



Across both formats, I want the editing to feel:



Clean. Thoughtful. Natural. Human.



Not generic viral content.



3. Thumbnails



You'll create thumbnails for:



* 4 monthly long-form videos

* Guided practices

* Occasional client testimonials



I already have an established visual direction and examples you'll be able to follow.



I'm looking for cinematic and emotionally interesting thumbnails rather than stereotypical YouTube clickbait.



Think movie poster / documentary frame rather than shocked faces, arrows and excessive text.



if you can improve the current state of my thumbnails, amazing!



4. YouTube Publishing



Once the content is approved, you'll take care of publishing and scheduling.



This includes:



* Uploading long-form videos and Shorts

* Adding provided links to descriptions

* Formatting descriptions

* Adding chapters/timestamps when appropriate

* Adding videos to the correct playlists

* Adding end screens/cards where appropriate

* Uploading thumbnails

* Scheduling content



---



EDITING STYLE — PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY



This is the most important part of this job posting.



I want an editor who knows when to edit and when to leave something alone.



My videos explore nervous system work, embodiment, self-discovery and deep personal transformation.



Sometimes silence matters.

Sometimes a breath matters.

Sometimes a pause is part of what makes the message land.



I don't want someone who automatically removes every second of silence because they believe viewers need constant stimulation.



You should be able to feel the difference between:



a pause that creates depth



and



a pause that simply needs to be edited out.



The overall feeling of the channel should be:



Cinematic.

Intimate.

Natural.

Warm.

Spacious.

Human.



Think documentary rather than traditional fast-paced YouTube.



The best edit should almost disappear into the content.



---



TOOLS & WORKFLOW



I currently use Descript and CapCut, and I want to keep my production workflow within these tools.



I primarily use:



Descript — long-form editing, transcript-based editing and audio



CapCut — Shorts, captions and additional visual editing



Projects should remain organized and accessible so I can easily review them or make small changes myself when necessary.



Experience with Descript and CapCut is strongly preferred.



If you're already excellent with CapCut but haven't used Descript extensively, that's okay as long as you're comfortable learning it quickly.



---



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



Must-haves



* Proven experience editing long-form YouTube content

* Experience editing Shorts

* Strong English comprehension

* Strong instinct for spoken-word pacing

* Good visual taste

* Reliable communication

* Consistent turnaround times

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow an established visual direction

* Comfortable working independently once you understand the brand

* Comfortable working with CapCut and/or Descript



Big bonuses



* Strong thumbnail design skills

* Previous experience with Descript

* Experience with wellness, coaching, educational or personal-development content

* Familiarity with feminine / cinematic / minimal visual styles

* Experience uploading and scheduling content directly on YouTube



---



COMPENSATION



My budget for this role is $350–500 USD/month, depending on experience, portfolio and the responsibilities you can confidently take over.



Please share the monthly retainer you would propose for the scope above.



$500 USD/month is my current maximum budget, not automatically the starting rate.



I'm looking for the right long-term fit rather than simply the cheapest candidate.



If we work well together and the channel grows, there is potential for both the role and compensation to grow over time.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. 2–3 examples of long-form YouTube videos you've personally edited



Ideally 10+ minute talking-head, educational, podcast or personal-brand content.



2. 2–3 Shorts you've edited



3. Examples of thumbnails you've designed, if applicable.



4. Your proposed monthly rate for the scope described above.



5. Tell me about your experience with Descript and CapCut.



6. Tell me about your availability and typical turnaround time.



7. Answer this question in 2–3 sentences:



What makes a talking-head video feel expensive and professional without over-editing it?



I'm interested in your personal editing instinct rather than a perfect answer.



---



PAID TEST



I will invite a small number of shortlisted candidates to complete the same paid editing test using footage from my channel.



The test will likely include:



* A short section of a long-form video

* One Short created from that footage

* Potentially one thumbnail



I'm much more interested in your taste, pacing and instinct than flashy editing.



I'm looking for someone who can stay with FeminaFlow long-term and truly learn the brand.



Eventually, I want you to understand my content and visual language well enough that I don't need to explain what a FeminaFlow video should feel like every single time.



I create and record. You help me turn it into a beautiful, consistent YouTube channel.

title: Estimating & Drafting Assistant / Bookkeeper (Stone Fabrication Company — US Client)
description:
Estimating / Bookkeeping / Purchasing Assistant



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote



We are a growing granite, quartz, and marble fabrication and installation company serving customers in the U.S.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and responsible team member to join us long-term. This is a full-time position for someone who can take responsibility for their work, follow instructions carefully, communicate well, and become an important part of our team.



The position involves supporting us in three main areas:



1. Drawings & Estimating



* Review job-site measurements, drawings, photos, and customer information.

* Create shop drawings and complete project plans.

* Prepare estimates and quotes using our software, including Stone App.

* Read and understand dimensions and measurements.

* Understand basic geometry, areas, and square-foot calculations.

* Make accurate drawings for countertops, islands, backsplashes, vanities, and other stone projects.

* Communicate with our team or customers when measurements or information are unclear.



Experience required: Stone App, SketchUp, AutoCAD, or similar CAD/drawing software.



2. Bookkeeping



* Record income and expenses.

* Create and send customer estimates and invoices.

* Keep financial records organized and up to date.

* Help maintain our books and accounting information.



Experience required: QuickBooks Online, or similar bookkeeping software.



3. Purchasing & Vendor Coordination



* Order slabs, materials, and supplies.

* Request and compare vendor pricing.

* Track orders and delivery dates.

* Communicate with suppliers when needed.

* Maintain an organized purchasing log.

* Follow up on orders to make sure materials arrive on time.



Requirements



* Strong written and spoken English.

* Comfortable joining video and phone calls.

* Very good attention to detail.

* Reliable and organized.

* Able to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Good computer skills.

* Experience in construction, countertops, stone fabrication, cabinetry, or a similar industry is a strong advantage.

* Must have a reliable, fast internet connection.

* Must have a backup internet/power solution in case of an outage.



What We Are Looking For



We are not looking for someone who only wants to complete simple tasks.



We are looking for someone who is reliable, takes ownership of their work, learns quickly, pays attention to details, and wants a long-term position with a growing company.



You should be comfortable asking questions when something is unclear, but also able to solve problems and work independently once you understand the process.



This is a long-term, full-time position, not a one-time project.

title: Operations & Marketing Systems Virtual Assistant
description:
I’m looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant to become the operational backbone of my growing leadership development, coaching, content, and podcast business.



This is not a “wait for instructions” VA role.



I am a big-picture entrepreneur who moves quickly, generates a lot of ideas, and (full disclosure) does not naturally love systems, processes, organization, or project management...That means I need someone who does!



The right person gets genuine satisfaction from creating order, building repeatable systems, keeping projects moving, noticing what has been forgotten, and making sure things actually get finished.



You should be comfortable saying:

“Here’s what we agreed to do.”

“This is due Thursday.”

“I still need this from you.”

“I noticed this hasn’t been updated, so I took care of it.”

“We keep doing this manually, so I created a process for it.”



I want someone who enjoys being the person behind the scenes who makes everything work, not someone who needs to be the face of the business or constantly receive recognition.



What You’ll Own:



 Marketing

• Draft, format, schedule, and QA
 campaigns

• Build and maintain
 sequences and automations

• Monitor
 deliverability, open rates, click rates, unsubscribes, etc.

• Implement
 marketing best practices and new strategies as we identify them

• Test links, automations, tags, forms, and sequences before campaigns go live

• Help identify opportunities to improve
 engagement and conversion



Kajabi, Funnels & Customer Experience

• Build and maintain Kajabi products and cohorts

• Create landing pages, opt-in pages, thank-you pages, and purchase pages

• Build marketing funnels for lead magnets, quizzes, webinars, and programs

• Maintain automated follow-up sequences for each lead magnet

• Maintain customer onboarding workflows

• Test the entire customer journey to make sure everything works correctly

• Identify gaps where leads or customers may be falling through the cracks



Website & Landing Pages

• Create and update landing pages

• Maintain website content, including publishing new podcast episodes once assets are handed off

• Make basic UX improvements

• Ensure links, forms, buttons, and integrations are functioning properly



Metrics & Reporting

Maintain a simple weekly/monthly business dashboard tracking things like:

• Lead magnet/freebie performance

• Quiz starts and completions

• Landing page traffic and conversion

• Website traffic

•
 list growth, open rates, and click rates

• Social follower growth and engagement (data supplied by the content team)

• Podcast performance

• Funnel conversion

• Webinar registration and attendance

• Program sales/conversions



I don’t just want numbers entered into a spreadsheet. I want someone who becomes familiar enough with the business to notice:

“Your
 clicks increased significantly this month.”

“A lot of people are starting the quiz but not completing it.”

“This landing page isn’t converting as well as the others.”



Launch Support

During program, webinar, or product launches, you’ll help manage the operational side of the launch, including:

• Create opt-in and registration pages

• Build
 sequences

• Create checkout/purchase pages

• Set up products and offers in Kajabi

• Build customer onboarding workflows

• Create and manage Zoom webinars/meetings 

• Manage invitations and reminder communications

• Attend live webinars and provide behind-the-scenes support

• Monitor chat/questions during webinars

• Test the entire funnel before launch

• Track registrations, attendance, sales, and conversion

• Keep launch timelines and deliverables organized



The Most Important Part of This Job: Keeping Me Organized

You will help build and maintain the operating system for the business. That means:

• Creating repeatable SOPs

• Maintaining project/task management systems

• Tracking recurring responsibilities

• Creating checklists and workflows

• Following up with me when you need something

• Keeping deadlines visible

• Anticipating upcoming needs

• Making sure important tasks don’t disappear

• Turning things we do repeatedly into documented processes

• Identifying things that can be automated or simplified



I need someone comfortable managing up. If you’re waiting for me to remember what needs to happen next, this probably isn’t the right role. If you naturally think, “Don’t worry, I already have that tracked,” we may be a great fit.



You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

• Extremely organized with a strong attention to detail. Systems, checklists, calendars, workflows, and project boards make your brain happy.

• Proactive. You don’t wait until someone notices a problem. You notice it first.

• A self-starter. Once you understand the goal, you can figure out how to move it forward.

• Comfortable holding someone accountable. You aren’t afraid to respectfully follow up with me or remind me that something is overdue.

• Resourceful. Your first instinct when you don’t know something is to research it, troubleshoot it, or figure it out.

• Detail-oriented. Broken links, incorrect dates, missing automations, formatting issues, and unfinished workflows bother you.

• Service-oriented. You genuinely enjoy making someone else’s life easier and helping a business run well.

• Happy behind the scenes. You don’t need to be the star. You take pride in being the person who quietly makes the machine run.

• Able to work independently. I don’t want to micromanage you—and I don’t want you to need me to.



Technology

Experience with several of these is strongly preferred:

• Kajabi

•
 marketing platforms

• Google Workspace

• Zoom

• Website/landing page builders

• Project management software

• Analytics/reporting dashboards



You don’t need to know every platform on Day 1. You do need to be technologically confident and comfortable teaching yourself new tools.



What Success Looks Like

Within a few months, I should be spending significantly less mental energy remembering, tracking, organizing, and following up on operational details.

• You know what needs to happen each week.

• Our recurring processes are documented.

• Funnels and automations work.

• Customers receive what they’re supposed to receive.

• Launches have clear timelines.

• Metrics are tracked.

• You proactively follow up with me when you’re waiting on something.

And increasingly, I hear: “Already handled.”



To Apply

Please send:

• A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

• Examples of businesses you’ve supported and what you personally owned.

• The platforms/tools you’re strongest in.

• Your availability and desired hourly/monthly rate.

And your favorite movie :) 



A short answer to this question: 

Imagine your client is highly creative, moves quickly, frequently changes priorities, and is terrible at consistently using project-management systems. What would you put in place to make sure important work still gets completed without constantly nagging them?



Please also tell me about a time you noticed something needed to be done before your client or manager asked you to do it. What did you do?



Please begin your application with the words “Already Handled” so I know you’ve read the entire posting.

title: Senior Executive & Personal Assistant | Operations
description:
Part-Time | 24 Hours/Week | Long-Term Remote Role | $6–8 p/hr



About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Executive & Personal Assistant to support the COO of a small group of privately held businesses, including a property management business. You will work alongside an established back-office team.

Your job is to manage the details, follow-up, people, and systems that would otherwise take up the COO's time — so she can focus on decisions, relationships, marketing, and revenue.



This is not an entry-level or first-time EA role. We're looking for someone with at least 5 years of experience supporting an executive, founder, or business owner — the industry doesn't have to match ours. This role tends to be the best fit for someone who has already had a full, demanding career and is now deliberately choosing part-time, flexible work over another full-time position — not someone early in their career building toward one. We will orient you to our specific businesses, accounts, and preferences.



How We Work

You will have real ownership of your work.



Examples:

• A vendor hasn't replied → follow up without being asked.

• An order arrived wrong → resolve it directly with the seller.

• Something needs to be scheduled → coordinate it end-to-end.

• Research is needed → compare 2–3 options and bring a recommendation, not just a list of links.



You do not need to report every small step. We care about the result. You'll have a back-office team, established vendors, and AI tools to support you. As you learn our systems, you'll be expected to judge what you can handle yourself, what the team or technology can handle, and what genuinely needs the COO's decision.



Close-the-loop ownership means: once you take on a task, you track it, follow up, and see it through to completion — bringing in the COO only when her decision or approval is actually required.

You should not need regular encouragement, check-ins or reassurance to stay on track. This role exists to create bandwidth for the COO — not to require bandwidth from her.



Reachability. This is a service role at its core — the job is being available and responsive when you're needed, not just completing a task list on your own schedule. The COO often calls from the car, the airport, between meetings, or while traveling — not always at a convenient moment for either of you. You need to be reachable and respond in real time when that happens, the same way you'd expect a vendor to pick up for you.



Business Operations

A significant part of this role supports our property management business. This is more involved than it may look on paper — several of these responsibilities require judgment, follow-through, and real ownership, not just task completion.



Primary Responsibilities

• Vendor management — channel-matched, never
-only. Find, call, schedule, and coordinate cleaners, landscapers, maintenance providers, and other service vendors.
 and text are never your default or primary channel — but you're expected to use whichever channel actually gets the job done, and to match the other person's preference rather than your own. If a vendor always calls and never
s, you call them. If someone only responds to text, you text them. Vendor relationships in this business are built and maintained through real conversations — following up on quotes and scheduling, resolving issues in real time, and confirming completed work by talking to people. Use our Quo phone system for calls. If something can be resolved with one phone call instead of a three
 back-and-forth, we expect the phone call.

• Project and follow-up ownership. Maintain one running list of open projects, deadlines, orders, claims, vendor commitments, and follow-ups, and personally move each one toward completion.

• Claims handling. Prepare and submit damage or insurance claims with supporting documentation (photos, receipts, correspondence), and follow up — including by phone with adjusters or vendors — until each claim is resolved.

• Inbox organization and AI-assisted triage. This starts with real organizational work: consolidate or close
 accounts we no longer need, and get every active inbox into a clean, folder-and-label structure with rules that sort mail automatically. Most incoming mail is not urgent — it's newsletters, receipts, and notifications, not decisions. Once the inbox is organized, help set up an AI-assisted system so routine, pre-approved categories are triaged or handled automatically, leaving only the small number of items each day that actually need a human decision.

• Cleaning coordination. Learn Breezeway (our cleaning and maintenance scheduling software) and confirm turnovers are scheduled correctly between guest stays.

• Listing and booking platform management. Keep our listing platforms accurate and current — pricing, availability, photos, and descriptions — following our established guidelines.

•
 marketing execution. Take campaign copy the COO writes and handle everything else: building the
, formatting, links, list selection, testing, scheduling, and sending.



Secondary Responsibilities

• Review responses. Reply to guest reviews using our approved tone and templates.

• Social media coordination. Our content team creates posts in batches. Check them against our content brief, request corrections if needed, schedule/post approved content, and confirm it is actually published.

• Calendar protection. Manage the COO's calendar to protect focus time and reduce unnecessary meetings or interruptions.

• Records management. Keep vendor contracts, warranties, receipts, and confirmations organized and easy to find.

• Vendor roster maintenance. Keep a clean, current directory of preferred vendors — service history, pricing where useful, and backup providers for each category — so nothing depends on your memory alone.

• Expense and receipt administration. Light receipt collection, reimbursement prep, invoice tracking, and flagging unusual or duplicate charges. This is not bookkeeping.

• Recurring obligations. Track subscriptions, software renewals, warranties and expiration dates so nothing lapses unnoticed.

• Systems hygiene. Keep shared drives, contact lists, account access, password-manager entries, and naming conventions organized and consistent.



Personal & Executive Support

You will also help keep the COO's personal and executive administration running smoothly. This may include:

• Grocery and Amazon ordering

• Handling purchases, returns, exchanges, refunds, and missing shipments

• Coordinating housekeeper, lawn care, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, and similar home vendors — channel-matched, same expectations as above

• Sourcing and vetting new vendors when needed

• Booking restaurant reservations and personal/service appointments

• Travel coordination (flights, hotels, car rental) using established preferences with Delta, Marriott, Hilton and Avis — itineraries, confirmations, changes and loyalty program tracking

• Holiday cards, birthday and graduation gifts, thank-you notes and similar social courtesies

• Setting up systems so important dates don't rely on the COO's memory

• Preparing short background briefs before social or business events

• Light calendar management

• Research tasks that end in a clear recommendation, not just a list of options

• Occasional special projects — the catch-all for things that don't happen often enough to earn their own bullet: events, gifts, household projects, one-off research, a relocation



Build Systems, Not Repeated Manual Work

When you notice yourself doing the same task more than twice, ask: "Can this be automated or templated instead?"

Examples: a saved/recurring grocery order, a birthday and holiday reminder calendar, a scheduled home-maintenance checklist, an
 rule, a vendor contact sheet, a reusable template, or an automation (e.g., using Zapier).

Your role is not simply to inherit repetitive clerical work — it's to reduce it wherever possible.



This also means you document as you go. If you were unexpectedly out for a month, someone else should be able to open your files and understand exactly how things work — without asking you. We're looking for someone who instinctively writes the SOP, saves the template, and shares it with the team, without being asked to.



Software & Tools

You should already be fluent in:

Google Workspace, Meta Business Suite, Asana, Canva, ChatGPT and Claude.



Drive organization matters a lot in this role. We expect meticulous filing: clear folder structures, logical subfolders, and consistent naming — the kind of system where anyone on the team can find what they need without asking you where it is.

You'll also learn our property management-specific tools:



Hospitable; Property management software — syncs bookings, messaging and calendars

Breezeway; Schedules and tracks cleaning and maintenance tasks between guest stays

Charge Automation; Handles guest security deposits and is a "personalized portal" for thier stay

Jotform; Builds online forms (e.g., guest intake, damage reports)

Quo;  VoIP business phone system for calls and texts



A note on training: We orient you to our specific accounts, preferences and workflows — we do not teach the underlying technology. You're expected to learn new platforms independently, and to build a real working relationship with each platform's support team: request a call, ask for a 1:1 walkthrough, push for real help when something isn't working. Submitting a ticket and passively waiting is not enough. If you're not comfortable reaching out and advocating for yourself with a vendor's support desk, this role will be difficult for you.



Home Office Requirements

This role is voice-heavy and time-sensitive, so your setup needs to hold up — a missed call or a dropped shift because of equipment or power isn't something we can work around. You'll need:

• A reliable primary internet connection, plus a backup option (mobile hotspot or a second ISP) for outages

• A VPN — non-negotiable, given the accounts and confidential information you'll be handling

• A backup laptop or device you can switch to if your primary one fails

• Backup power (generator, UPS, or similar) for power interruptions

• A quiet, private, professional space to work and take calls without background noise or interruptions

• A noise-cancelling headset — you'll be on the phone regularly with vendors and service providers, and call quality matters

If you don't currently have all of this in place, tell us how you'd close the gap rather than not applying.

Who Will Do Well in This Role

• Has at least 5 years of experience and has held genuine ownership-level responsibility supporting an executive, founder or business owner before — possibly in a different industry than ours

• Has already had a full career and is intentionally choosing part-time, flexible work at this stage — not looking to grow this into a full-time position

• Strong written and spoken English, since you'll represent the COO directly with vendors and service providers by phone

• Comfortable being the one who picks up the phone when a call is what the situation calls for — this is not an
-and-text-only role, even though you'll use every channel

• Organized, discreet with confidential information, and reliable without needing reminders

• Proactive: notices what needs to happen next and acts, rather than waiting for instructions

• Works well with a team and can coordinate tasks through others, not just solo

• Learns new software independently and isn't afraid to ask a vendor's support team for real help — a passive person who just files a ticket and waits will not do well here

• Documents and systematizes as a habit — writes the SOP and shares it without being asked

• Brings a recommendation when flagging a problem, rather than just reporting it

• Good judgment about what needs the COO's input versus what can simply be resolved





Daily Check-Ins

Two short meetings each workday:

• Start of day (15 minutes): agree on priorities for the day

• End of day (15 minutes): review what was completed, what's still in progress, and anything that needs the COO's decision



Outside of these check-ins, your time is your own to execute the work.





Schedule & Compensation

This is a part-time, 24 hours/week, long-term remote position, requiring availability during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) working hours:

Day Hours (ET) Approx. Philippine Time (PHT, UTC+8)*

Monday, Wednesday, Friday 6 hrs — 7:00 AM–1:00 PM ET 7:00 PM–1:00 AM PHT

Tuesday, Thursday 3 hrs — 7:00–10:00 AM ET 7:00–10:00 PM PHT

*ET is 12 hours behind PHT for most of the year (EDT) and 13 hours behind during U.S. winter months (EST, roughly early November–early March), when the PHT window shifts about an hour later. Exact conversion will be confirmed during scheduling.



You are free to take on other clients or work outside these scheduled hours. This role does not include benefits.

Starting rate: $6–$8 USD/hour, based on experience. Rate increases are available based on performance.



How to Apply

This is a single-step application, and how you follow these instructions is itself part of what we're evaluating — clear writing, on-time delivery, and attention to detail matter as much as the content.



Submit one message containing all three parts below, by [DEADLINE — e.g., 5:00 PM ET on a specific date]. Late submissions, or submissions missing a required part, will not be reviewed.



Subject line: exactly [EXACT REQUIRED TEXT — e.g., “EA/PA-Ops Application — Your Name”]

In the body, in 150 words or fewer: your availability, your requested hourly rate, LinkedIn profile link, and confirmation that you have the home office setup described above (or, if you don't yet, how you'd close the gap).



A link to one video (screen and voice, no editing), structured in two parts:

• Start on screen. Screen-share something real from how you already work: your folder/file system, an SOP you built, a task tracker, or how you organize a client's inbox. Redact or blur anything confidential.

• Then answer these live and unscripted, in your own environment — talk us through them as you think; don't pre-write and read:

– Tell us about a time you had to learn a new piece of software or system with no formal training. What did you do when you got stuck?

– Walk us through the SOP or system you just showed us — why you built it, and who else uses it.

– Tell us about a vendor follow-up or scheduling problem you solved by picking up the phone, not by
ing.

– What is something a previous employer eventually trusted you to own completely, with no check-ins or oversight?

– What drew you to this specific role, and why does it fit where you are right now — in your career, your family life, or your life in general? We'd rather understand your “why now” than hear a generic answer about the job description.



We're looking for an experienced person who can step into an existing setup, create order, and get things done with minimal supervision — starting now, not after weeks of onboarding.

title: Fractional Multi-Entity Accountant / Accounting Specialist
description:
Work Arrangement: Part-Time / Fractional Independent Contractor

Location: Philippines – Metro Manila preferred

Initial Workload: Approximately 8–12 hours per week; up to 45 hours per month included in base engagement

Reporting: Operationally to Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator; financial reporting and escalation directly to Founder/CEO

Initial Engagement: 90-day evaluation period



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized, trustworthy and detail-oriented accountant to support the accounting operations of several U.S.-based businesses, including a growing travel and hospitality business and a professional services firm.



This is not a traditional full-time accounting position and is not intended to be a purely transactional bookkeeping role.



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate books and records, performing reconciliations, supporting accounts payable and receivable processes, tracking commissions and business expenses, preparing management reports, and maintaining clear financial records across multiple business entities.



The position requires exceptional discretion and confidentiality because the accountant will have access to sensitive business and financial information.



The role is initially expected to require approximately 8–12 hours per week, with additional hours during month-end, year-end or periods of increased activity.



Primary Responsibilities

Accounting and Reconciliation

Maintain accurate accounting records for multiple business entities.

Reconcile bank, credit card and designated payment-platform accounts.

Review and categorize business expenses.

Identify discrepancies, duplicates, missing transactions and unusual activity.

Maintain supporting documentation for transactions.

Assist with intercompany and related-entity reconciliations when required.

Maintain accurate accounts payable and accounts receivable records.

Prepare recurring journal entries and month-end adjustments as appropriate.

Monthly Close and Management Reporting



Support a disciplined monthly close process and prepare a monthly management package that includes, as applicable:



Profit and loss statement

Balance sheet

Cash position

Accounts receivable

Accounts payable

Budget versus actual results

Major expense variances

Commission receivables

Contractor and payroll expense reconciliation

Business-unit or project profitability

Outstanding accounting issues

90-day cash-flow outlook



The accountant should be capable of identifying and explaining significant discrepancies rather than simply producing reports.



Travel Business Accounting



For Travel Hike & Eat and related travel operations:



Track travel supplier and agency commissions.

Reconcile Fora and other supplier commission statements.

Track commission receivables.

Assist with traveler and trip payment reconciliation when required.

Maintain trip-level revenue and expense accounting.

Prepare trip-level profitability reports.

Track deposits, refunds and vendor payments.

Assist with financial reconciliation of group trips and optional excursions.

Support calculation of gross profit and employee incentive pools when applicable.

Payroll, Contractor and Vendor Support

Reconcile EOR and contractor invoices.

Track recurring vendors and business expenses.

Review supporting documentation for reimbursements.

Assist with contractor payment records.

Maintain accounting records supporting payroll and outside service providers.

Prepare records required by external tax professionals and CPAs.

Multi-Entity Responsibilities



The accountant may support multiple businesses under common ownership.



Each entity must be maintained independently with clear separation of:



Bank accounts

Expenses

Revenue

Contracts

Vendor payments

Accounting records

Financial reporting



The accountant must demonstrate an understanding of maintaining proper entity separation and avoiding inappropriate commingling of business transactions.



Financial Controls



This position is an accounting and reporting role and does not carry independent authority to move company funds.



Unless expressly authorized by the Founder/CEO, the accountant will not:



Approve payments

Execute wires or transfers

Add or modify banking beneficiaries

Change banking instructions

Sign checks

Open or close financial accounts

Obtain credit

Commit a company to financial obligations

Make investments

Transfer funds between entities



The accountant may prepare payments or supporting documentation for review when specifically authorized, but final financial authorization remains with the Founder/CEO.



Confidentiality and Information Security



This position requires a high degree of trust.



The successful candidate must agree to strict confidentiality and data-security requirements, including:



Use of company-approved systems and accounts.

Multi-factor authentication on required systems.

No sharing of usernames, passwords or credentials.

No subcontracting of assigned work.

No unauthorized copying or downloading of company financial information.

No storage of sensitive company data on personal devices or personal cloud-storage accounts.

Use of company-provided or company-approved equipment for sensitive financial work.

Immediate reporting of suspected security i
.

Return or deletion of company information upon termination as directed.

Continued confidentiality obligations after the engagement ends.



Access to financial systems will be provided according to the principle of least privilege and may be expanded as responsibilities develop.



Qualifications



Preferred candidates should have:



Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a closely related field.

Approximately 3–5 years of relevant accounting experience.

Strong practical bookkeeping and reconciliation experience.

Experience supporting multiple entities, business units or clients.

Strong knowledge of general ledger accounting.

Experience preparing monthly financial statements.

Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting platforms.

Strong written and spoken English.

Exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and meet recurring deadlines.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Demonstrated discretion handling confidential financial information.

Preferred Experience



Additional consideration will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following:



U.S.-based businesses

U.S. GAAP accounting environments

Professional services firms

Travel agencies, hospitality or tourism businesses

Commission accounting

Multi-entity accounting

Project or job-cost accounting

International contractors or EOR providers

Wise or other international payment platforms

QuickBooks Online

Management reporting

Cash-flow forecasting



CPA licensure is welcome but is not required.



We place greater value on strong operational accounting ability, accuracy, judgment and reliability than on credentials alone.



Working Relationship



The accountant will work closely with the Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator for documentation, scheduling and workflow coordination.



The accountant will have direct access to the Founder/CEO for financial reporting and must independently escalate:



Material discrepancies

Unusual transactions

Suspected fraud

Internal-control weaknesses

Repeated missing documentation

Significant accounting errors

Potential conflicts of interest

Security concerns

Compensation



Initial compensation is structured as a monthly fractional retainer.



Base Retainer: ₱22,000 per month



The retainer includes up to 45 hours of accounting services per month.



Pre-approved work beyond 45 hours will be compensated at ₱500 per hour.



Additional work beyond 65 total hours in a month requires specific approval from the Founder/CEO.



The engagement will initially operate under a 90-day evaluation period.



A discretionary performance bonus may be considered based upon accuracy, timeliness, reporting quality, reliability and overall contribution.



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured primarily by:



Accuracy of accounting records

Timely completion of reconciliations

Timely month-end close

Quality of financial reporting

Identification and resolution of discrepancies

Maintenance of proper entity separation

Responsiveness

Organization and documentation

Security and confidentiality

Reduction in the accounting administrative burden placed on management



The objective of this role is not simply to record transactions. The accountant should help management maintain reliable financial information from which sound business decisions can be made.

title: Personal & Executive Assistant Highly Organized & Detail Oriented
description:
We are looking for an exceptional Personal + Executive Assistant to support a fast-moving female entrepreneur and business owner.



This is NOT a position for someone who simply waits for a list of tasks. We need someone who naturally loves organization, details, follow-through, reminders, communication, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. This is a support role. You must love helping people take the load off and make things easier for her. 



She is highly motivated, direct, fast-moving, and excellent at big-picture thinking, decision-making and leadership. She does NOT enjoy managing all the little details that come with business, family, meetings, projects and schedules.



Your job is to become her right-hand person for organization and execution.



You will help:



Attend meetings, take notes and capture action items

Maintain her task list and priorities

Keep track of commitments and deadlines

Remind her of things she needs to do

Follow up with her when something hasn't been completed

Follow up with team members and make sure tasks get done 

Communicate with team members on her behalf

Coordinate business and personal calendars

Help organize family appointments and commitments

Turn quick voice messages into organized tasks and next steps

Schedule appointments, research options and handle logistics

Notice unfinished tasks and proactively close the loop

Prepare her for upcoming meetings

Keep track of what's coming up, what's waiting on someone else, and what needs her attention



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should be extremely detail-oriented, proactive and dependable. You love checklists, notice things others miss, naturally follow up, and don't need someone constantly telling you what to do next.



You must also be comfortable working with someone who communicates quickly and directly. We WANT you to remind her. We WANT you to follow up. We WANT you to catch things she has forgotten.



The ultimate goal is for her to be able to think:



"I don't have to remember everything because I know my assistant has it handled."



HOURS & PAY



10–15 hours per week

Approximately $500 USD/month

Remote

Availability during U.S. Mountain Time business hours is required



HOW TO APPLY



Please tell us:



Why you believe you're unusually good at organization and details.

Give us an example of how you've kept a busy person or team organized.

What tools have you used for calendars, task management and communication?

What are your normal working hours and time zone?



Attention-to-detail test: Somewhere in your application, include the exact words "I close the loop."



Finally, answer this:



Your boss messages you at 9:00 AM:



"I need to schedule the kids' dentist appointments, remind Josh about the numbers he owes me, prepare for my 2:00 meeting, get Sarah the information she asked for yesterday, and remember to talk to my husband tonight about our plans for next week."



Tell us exactly what you would do next.



We want to see how you think, prioritize, organize, and follow through and take initiative.

title: Senior E-Commerce Product, Marketplace & Creative Specialist AU Based Dayshift!
description:
About Us



Oz Best Dealz / Cobra 4x4 is an established Australian e-commerce business specialising in 4WD accessories, automotive products and outdoor gear.



We sell through our own website and multiple online marketplaces across Australia. We are looking for an experienced, intelligent and highly organised e-commerce professional to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



This is not a basic VA or data-entry position.



We want someone who can take ownership of products from start to finish — research them, create professional listings, improve images, write persuasive content, price and categorise products correctly, publish them across different sales channels and make sure everything is accurate before it goes live.



We want someone who thinks for themselves, notices problems, comes up with ideas and does not require constant micromanagement.



Working Arrangement

• Remote position – Philippines 

• Initially around 3 full days per week 

• Opportunity to increase to 4 days per week 

• Potential to become a much larger/full-time role for the right person 

• Long-term position — we are not looking for someone who wants a short-term freelance project 

• You must be reliably available during your agreed working hours 

• Indicative rate: US$8–$12/hour depending on experience 

• Higher rates may be considered for an exceptional candidate with strong e-commerce, creative, marketplace, SEO and Klaviyo experience



Your Main Responsibilities



1. Creating Complete E-Commerce Product Listings



This will be one of the most important parts of your job.

You may receive supplier information, photos, specifications and basic product details and be expected to turn them into a complete professional product listing.



This includes:

• Creating products in Neto / Maropost Commerce Cloud 

• Writing strong product titles 

• Writing persuasive product descriptions 

• Creating clear features and benefits 

• Researching products when necessary 

• Understanding product specifications 

• Checking vehicle fitment and compatibility 

• Creating and managing variations 

• Correctly categorising products 

• Setting and checking pricing 

• Sale pricing and promotional pricing 

• Entering SKUs, brands, dimensions, specifications and attributes 

• Uploading and organising images 

• Checking spelling, formatting and presentation 

• Making sure the listing looks professional before publishing 



We don't want someone simply copying and pasting supplier information.



We want someone who understands how to turn technical information into something a customer will actually want to buy.



2. Product Image Editing & Creative Work



You should be comfortable improving product photos and creating professional advertising material.



Experience with tools such as:

• Canva 

• Photoshop or similar image-editing software 

• CapCut 

• Higgsfield 

• AI image tools 

• AI video tools 

Tasks may include:

• Cleaning supplier images 

• Removing backgrounds 

• Improving image quality 

• Resizing and cropping 

• Colour correction 

• Adding dimensions 

• Creating feature graphics 

• Product comparison graphics 

• Website banners 

• Promotional graphics 

• Social media creatives 

• Advertising images 



3. Marketplace Listings



You should ideally have experience managing products across different marketplaces such as:

• eBay 

• Amazon 

• Google Shopping / Merchant Center 

• Meta /
 
 

• Other e-commerce marketplaces 



You should understand:

• Marketplace titles 

• Categories 

• Item specifics 

• Attributes 

• Pricing 

• Shipping information 

• Product images 

• Marketplace optimisation 

• Fixing rejected or incorrect listings 



You should understand that the best listing for our website may not always be exactly the same as the best listing for eBay, Google Shopping or another marketplace.



3. Copywriting & Selling



We want someone who understands how to sell, not just how to describe something.



For example, don't simply write:

“304 Stainless Steel.”



Understand why the customer cares:

“304 stainless steel construction provides excellent corrosion resistance and long-term durability.”



You should be able to identify:

• Customer pain points 

• Product benefits 

• Key selling points 

• Competitive advantages 

• Strong calls to action 

• Features that should be highlighted 

Experience in direct-response advertising or e-commerce sales copywriting is highly desirable.



4. SEO Knowledge



Strong SEO knowledge is a bonus.



Ideally you understand the basics of:

• Keyword research 

• SEO-friendly product titles 

• Product descriptions 

• Meta titles 

• Meta descriptions 

• Image alt text 

• Internal linking 

• Google Shopping optimisation 

• Search intent 

• Avoiding keyword stuffing 

We don't necessarily need an SEO specialist, but we want someone who naturally thinks about how customers search for products.



5. Video, Social Media & Advertising Content



You may also help create:

• Instagram Reels 

•
 ads 

• TikTok videos 

• YouTube Shorts 

• Product videos 

• Meta advertisements 

• Promotional campaigns 

• Website advertising graphics 

Experience with Higgsfield, CapCut, Canva and modern AI creative tools is highly regarded.

We especially like people who can look at a product and come up with their own advertising ideas and hooks.



6. Klaviyo – Highly Desirable Bonus



Experience with Klaviyo would be a major advantage.



Ideally you can help with:

• EDM creation 

• Promotional
s 

•
 design 

•
 copywriting 

• Subject lines 

• Welcome flows 

• Abandoned cart flows 

• Browse abandonment 

• Post-purchase flows 

• Win-back flows 

• Segmentation 

• A/B testing 

This isn't necessarily the main responsibility of the role, but strong Klaviyo experience will make you a much stronger candidate.



7. The Person We Are Looking For



This part is extremely important.



We want someone who is:

• Highly intelligent 

• Extremely thorough 

• Detail-oriented 

• Reliable 

• Organised 

• Creative 

• Commercially minded 

• Good at solving problems 

• Comfortable researching things they don't know 

• Confident making sensible decisions 

• Able to recognise when something doesn't look right 

• Able to check their own work 

• Comfortable taking ownership 

• Able to work without constant supervision 



We are NOT looking for someone who needs instructions for every small task.



We will train you on our company, products and systems. However, once you understand the business, we expect you to think independently. If you receive a product and something doesn't make sense, we expect you to investigate it.

If a price looks wrong, we expect you to notice. If product fitment information contradicts itself, we expect you to notice.

If an image doesn't look professional, we expect you to fix it. If a product description isn't convincing, we expect you to improve it. We expect you to check your own work before asking someone else to check it.



What Would Make You an Exceptional Candidate?



Someone we can send:

Supplier information + photos + specifications + product cost

and simply say:

“Get this ready for sale.”

You can then independently:

Research → understand → edit images → write content → identify selling points → create the product → price it → categorise it → optimise it → publish it → list it on marketplaces → check everything → tell us it's ready.

If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.

title: Capital Raise Deck Editor
description:
# Capital Raise Deck Editor



We are looking for a *Capital Raise Deck Editor* who can turn financial, operational, and technical information into clear, professional, investor-ready presentations.



This is not simply a graphic design role. You should understand how to structure an investment story, communicate an opportunity clearly, and present information in a way that helps prospective investors understand the thesis, economics, risks, and potential returns.



### What You'll Do



* Create, edit, and maintain *capital raise decks and investor presentations*.

* Turn raw notes, financial data, operational information, and technical materials into polished, easy-to-understand slides.

* Structure decks with a clear investor journey—from the opportunity and investment thesis through asset details, economics, structure, risks, and next steps.

* Build and improve charts, tables, financial visuals, timelines, and other presentation elements.

* Maintain a *clean, institutional, and professional design style* rather than overly promotional or flashy presentations.

* Review every deck for numerical accuracy, consistency, grammar, formatting, and overall presentation quality.

* Ensure all statements and figures remain consistent with the underlying source materials without introducing unsupported claims or assumptions.

* Update presentations as financial assumptions, project information, offering terms, or operations change.

* Work directly with leadership and turn around revisions quickly.

* Maintain organized versions of decks and supporting materials.



### What We're Looking For



* Strong experience with *PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, or similar presentation tools*.

* Experience creating *capital raise decks, investor presentations, pitch decks, financial presentations, or offering materials*.

* Strong understanding of presentation structure and investor storytelling.

* Comfortable working with financial figures, investment terminology, charts, tables, and return metrics.

* Excellent written English and the ability to simplify complex information without losing accuracy.

* Strong visual judgment and exceptional attention to detail.

* Ability to take incomplete or unorganized information and independently turn it into a polished presentation.

* Comfortable receiving direct feedback and making revisions quickly.

* Experience using AI tools to improve research, writing, design, and workflow efficiency.

* Experience in *oil & gas, energy, private equity, alternative investments, real estate syndication, or financial services* is a strong advantage.



### What Success Looks Like



You can receive a combination of financial models, project information, technical notes, existing materials, and leadership direction and turn them into a presentation that is *clear, credible, institutional, and investor-ready*.



You understand that a capital raise deck isn't just about making slides look good. *Every number, chart, statement, and visual needs to serve the investment story and accurately reflect the underlying opportunity. *



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the finished product, understands what prospective investors need to see, catches details others may miss, and consistently produces materials we are confident putting in front of investors.



If you are interested, please message me on my
:

title: Sales Director
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, revenue-focused Sales Director who combines high-level commercial leadership with hands-on, front-line execution. 



This is not a traditional hands-off or relationship-management role. We are looking for a true "player-coach" and new-business hunter who has a proven history of delivering revenue, personally closing deals, and building high-performing sales engines. In addition to defining overarching revenue strategies and establishing repeatable sales processes, the ideal candidate is ready to roll up their sleeves—actively participating in prospecting, executing cold outreach campaigns, setting appointments, and leading high-value negotiations with U.S. decision-makers from start to finish. 





Key Responsibilities

 Hands-On Prospecting & Pipeline Generation:

o Lead from the front by actively executing and supporting outbound prospecting campaigns. 

o Conduct cold calling, multi-touch
 campaigns, and personalized outreach across phone,
, social platforms, and networking channels to identify customer pain points and uncover opportunities. 

o Set qualified appointments, qualify leads, and conduct in-depth discovery calls and product presentations with prospective clients. 



o Collaborate with the marketing team to design and deploy targeted campaigns that generate and nurture qualified sales pipelines. 



 Strategic Leadership & Revenue Growth:

o Own and drive the end-to-end new-business sales strategy and revenue plan across target U.S. markets. 

o Identify and develop new market opportunities while building, optimizing, and maintaining a high-quality, predictable sales pipeline. 

o Set and monitor sales targets, revenue objectives, and operational KPIs. 

o Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline velocity analysis, and revenue reporting. 



 Deal Negotiation & Full-Cycle Closing:

o Lead the complete sales cycle from initial contact and discovery through proposal presentation, contract negotiation, and close. 

o Personally engage in high-value, strategic sales opportunities and negotiate directly with senior decision-makers (C-suite, VPs, and Business Owners). 

o Coordinate with internal operations and recruitment teams to ensure client requirements are properly translated into high-impact solutions. 



 Process Optimization & Team Coaching:

o Develop repeatable sales processes, objection-handling methodologies, and prospecting best practices. 

o Drive accountability around activity volume, outreach consistency, pipeline quality, conversion rates, and revenue. 

o Coach, mentor, and upskill sales team members to improve overall conversion efficiency. 

o Maintain clean pipeline tracking and accurate client records in Salesforce and related lead management platforms. 



Qualifications & Requirements

 Experience:

o At least 10 years of sales experience with significant B2B sales and new-business acquisition experience. 

o Prior commercial leadership experience (e.g., Sales Director, Head of Sales, or Senior Sales Manager) combined with a proven track record of personally originating and closing deals. 

o Proven background in hands-on lead generation, cold calling, and appointment setting targeting U.S.-based companies. 



 Track Record of Performance:

o Demonstrated, quantifiable history of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. 

o Ability to clearly articulate and quantify commercial metrics, such as average deal size, sales cycle length, opportunity-to-close conversion rates, deals closed per month, and total revenue generated. 



 Communication & Interpersonal Skills:

o Fluent, client-ready English with excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

o Highly skilled at consultative selling, asking probing questions, and uncovering customer pain points to position solutions effectively. 

o Confident and polished when presenting and negotiating with C-level executives. 



 Technical Proficiency:

o Working knowledge and proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM systems. 

o Experience with communication and calling tools such as RingCentral and lead management platforms. 



 Work Schedule:

o Must be amenable to working on a night shift schedule aligned with U.S. business hours. 



Preferred Background

Candidates with specific industry experience selling to U.S. businesses in the following sectors will have a strong advantage:

• Construction services and materials 

• Financing, commercial lending, or related professional business services

title: Virtual Assistant (Project-Based)
description:
About the Role



I'm looking for a sharp, self-directed virtual assistant to help me across my personal and business projects — general operations, content support, and my own online community work (this is separate from an AI community I run, which has its own dedicated support already). This is flexible, project-based work where you'll take ownership of assignments and run with them.



Here's the most important thing to know: I'm not looking for someone who already knows every tool. I'll teach you the systems, workflows, and processes you need. What I can't teach — and what I'm actually looking for — is mindset.



Who You Are (This Matters Most)



Ownership: You treat the work as your own. When something needs doing, you take it across the finish line without being chased.



Independent thinking: You solve problems on your own before escalating. You figure things out rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.



Initiative: You anticipate what's needed and act on it, instead of waiting to be told.



Reliability & follow-through: When you say you'll do something, it gets done — completely, and on time.



What You'll Help With



Project-based tasks I assign directly (research, content support, administrative work, backlog cleanup, and more)



Tasks assigned through the AI delegation system I'm building — a growing share of your work will be scoped and handed to you this way rather than by me personally. You don't need to understand how that system works, just execute what's asked and flag anything unclear.



Supporting my own online community and content work — separate from the AI mastermind community I run, which already has dedicated support



My YouTube channel — helping with posting, video preparation, and general channel growth



Helping keep my projects organized and on track



Bringing ideas and initiative, not just execution



How This Works



This is project-based, not fixed weekly hours, at a rate of $5/hour. Here's the flow:



We align on a defined chunk of work — a $100 increment, roughly 20 hours at this rate.



I'll scope what needs to be done and allocate it to you (sometimes this scoping will come through the AI system rather than from me directly).



You complete the work, I review and validate it, and we close it out.



Then we scope the next increment — and we grow from there, continuously, as more work comes up.



This means the work flows in defined, completable chunks rather than open-ended hours — so you always know exactly what "done" looks like.



Availability



Regular sync: I'd like you available for a check-in Mondays and Fridays at 2:30–3:00 PM PST (US Pacific) to align on work and review progress. (Early on, these check-ins will also help you get up to speed; they'll stay flexible as you settle in.)



Occasional urgent sync: On rare occasions, if something time-sensitive comes up, I may need you available on a Saturday morning PST for a quick sync. This will be uncommon, but I need someone who can be reachable when it genuinely matters.



Time zone: All times listed are US Pacific — I welcome applicants from anywhere, as long as these specific windows work for you.



Requirements



Reliable internet and a quiet work environment



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail



Comfortable learning new technology and taking direction from both me and an AI-driven task system



Good working English (you can use AI tools to help polish written communication)



Able to make the Monday and Friday PST check-ins, and occasionally available for a rare urgent Saturday-morning PST sync



Nice to Have (But Not Required)



Familiarity with AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT)



AI experience generally is a plus, but not required — mindset matters more



Experience with content creation, video/YouTube support, or online community work



Compensation



This role pays $5/hour. Work is structured in $100 increments — roughly 20 hours each — with a defined scope agreed upfront for every increment, so you always know exactly what you're being paid for before you start.



How to Apply



I don't want a résumé full of tool names. I want to see how you think. So here's a scenario — tell me how you'd handle it:



You're a few days into helping me clean up a backlog of open projects. One task on the list is marked as already finished, so you skip past it — but partway through your work, you notice something that makes you suspect it actually isn't done, and it looks time-sensitive. I'm unreachable for the next few hours.



Tell me: What do you do, and why? Walk me through your thinking.



There's no single "right" answer — I want to see how you approach a problem, take ownership, and think it through on your own. Please write a few short paragraphs, and confirm in your application that the $5/hour rate works for you.



I'm far more interested in your thinking than in a polished résumé.



(Applications that skip the scenario won't be considered.)

title: Senior LinkedIn Appointment Setter | Replies + Booking | 4h/day Salary up to $800/mo
description:
We are looking for a senior LinkedIn appointment setter to join one of the most exciting companies in the AI video production industry. If you are experienced, sharp, and you love turning conversations into booked calls, keep reading, this could be the role you have been waiting for.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. We are looking for an experienced, seasoned LinkedIn appointment setter.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls may enter the system over time, and for the right person that is a real opportunity to grow.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 100 per account per day, roughly 200 per day in total

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. Experience: minimum 2 years appointment setting, minimum 1 year on LinkedIn specifically



Two years minimum in appointment setting, with at least one of those years in LinkedIn DM setting specifically: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full dedication during working hours



We are looking for someone fully dedicated to the company during their working hours, with no other job at the same time. Those hours may increase over time as the role grows.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $550 USD per month, around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Realistic total at full speed: $625 to $850 per month. For a 4-hour role, that is top-of-market pay in the Philippines, and it is deliberate. We want to be the job you prioritize.



Hours: around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday. Monday to Friday is your main setting time, and Saturday is a shorter one focused on reactivation messages. Your daily hours sit in a fixed window, morning or afternoon Philippine time, agreed at interview based on the team's coverage needs and your availability, and they stay fixed once agreed.



>> HOW TO APPLY



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video. 

Both are required for the application to be complete.



PART ONE, IN WRITING



1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" in capital letters. It simply tells us you read the post. Otherwise your application will not be taken into account in our system.



2. Answer these two questions in your own words:



Question 1: Look at 
. 

In 3 to 5 sentences, in your own words: what do you think we help people do?



Question 2: A prospect has told you twice that our program looks interesting. On your third message you ask to book a 15-minute call. He replies: "Honestly I'm fully booked until next month, let's talk then." Write the exact message you would send back, word for word, as you would really send it. One message only.



3. Your experience, in short and precise points:



- How many years of appointment setting, and for which companies or clients

- How many of those years on LinkedIn specifically

- What offers you were setting for, and at what price point

- Which outreach or conversational tools you have used

- How many messages you were sending per day at your busiest

- How many conversations you were handling at the same time at your busiest

- Your internet setup and your power backup plan, in one or two lines

- Every job, client or commitment you currently have, with the hours. Write "None" if you have none.

- One line confirming you understand this role is conversational: no lead generation, no scraping, no list building



4. Attach three documents:



- Your CV

- A Speedtest screenshot, taken where you will usually work

- A photo of your workstation, taken with your phone



PART TWO, THE VIDEO



Record a video of yourself, 1 to 2 minutes, face on camera. Keep it simple and natural:



- Introduce yourself: who you are, your hobbies, what you enjoy doing

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience in your own words



You can record it with a free tool like Loom (
): it records you from your browser and gives you a link to paste into your application. Any similar tool works, as long as we can see and hear you clearly.



We use this video for two things: your spoken English and your personality. We are looking for someone engaging, with energy. No script needed, just talk to us.



>> WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application, your video and your attachments.

2. Selected candidates have a 30-minute video call with the founders.

3. We ask for one previous employer contact for a reference call.

4. Shortlisted candidates start with a one-week onboarding, followed by a one-week trial on real conversations.



>> AUTOMATIC REJECTION



X No presentation video

X No photo of the workstation

X No Speedtest screenshot

X The application does not start with MANGO

X Less than 2 years appointment setting experience

X Applications pitching lead generation, scraping or research services

X Generic, copy-pasted or AI-written text with nothing personal in it

X An unclear situation regarding other jobs and clients



>> A FINAL WORD



We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.



What matters most to us: honesty, discipline, consistency, fast learning, and a real human understanding of people. The offer and the scripts, we will train you on.



If that is you, apply carefully and completely. We will be very happy to meet you.



Xtendency.ai
