Aura Cosmetic Clinics is a fast-growing cosmetic clinic company in Arizona, USA. We are building our internal call center and looking for a highly driven individual in the Philippines who can start hands-on and grow into managing our call center team.



SPEED TO LEAD IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT IN THIS ROLE.



Our goal is simple: when a new lead comes in, we want to be the fastest company to contact them.



New leads must be called immediately whenever possible. You will be responsible for monitoring incoming leads throughout your shift and making sure no lead sits untouched.



Your Responsibilities

Call new leads immediately after they enter our system

Maintain the fastest possible speed-to-lead throughout your shift

Call, text, and follow up with leads until contact is made

Book qualified prospects for consultations at our Arizona clinics

Confirm appointments and actively work to reduce no-shows

Follow structured call scripts and follow-up sequences

Keep accurate notes and lead statuses inside our CRM

Re-engage older leads who haven't booked

Communicate with our marketing companies regarding lead volume, lead quality, campaign performance, and issues

Track KPIs including speed-to-lead, contact rate, booking rate, show rate, calls made, and appointments showed

Identify problems in the lead pipeline quickly and report them to management

Help improve scripts, follow-up systems, and call-center processes

Eventually train, coach, and supervise additional appointment setters

Monitor team calls and ensure every representative meets performance standards

Provide management with clear daily and weekly KPI reports

Performance Bonuses



You earn additional bonuses for every qualified appointment you book that actually SHOWS UP to the clinic.



We don't measure success only by how many appointments are scheduled. We care about how many qualified prospects actually walk through our doors.



The better your contact rate, booking rate, and show rate, the more you can earn.



As you grow into the Call Center Manager position, additional team-performance bonuses may be available based on the results of the representatives you manage.



Our #1 Expectation: SPEED



When a new lead submits their information, every minute matters.



You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where incoming leads are monitored continuously during your shift.



New lead → Call immediately → Text → Follow-up → Book → Confirm → SHOW.



We want someone who becomes obsessed with making sure opportunities do not fall through the cracks.



Who We're Looking For

Excellent spoken and written English

Strong and confident phone presence

Experience speaking with U.S. customers

BPO, call center, appointment-setting, sales, or lead-generation experience

Team Lead/Supervisor experience strongly preferred

Comfortable being measured against daily KPIs

Extremely fast and responsive

Strong CRM and computer skills

Organized and detail-oriented

title: Social Media Manager + Operations Assistant
description:
I'm looking for one person to be my right hand: half social media and design, half operations. If you're great at Canva and the kind of person who can't stand a messy project board, keep reading.



This is a long-term role with a real growth path, not a gig. Details on that at the bottom.



About Us:



Carson Poore Consulting is a small marketing company in Indiana. We help local business owners grow through better branding, marketing, and advertising. I'm Carson, and right now the company is me. You'd be the first hire, which means you help build how this thing runs.



Four things we actually believe:



Build it better. There's always a sharper version of what we just made, and we go find it before the client asks.

Kind and candid. We tell the truth and we're nice about it. Both, at the same time.

Nothing half-checked. If our name is on it, someone looked at it twice.

Founders over funnels. The person matters more than the pipeline.



If that sounds like how you already work, we'll get along.



What you'll do



Design social graphics in Canva using established brand kits (the biggest part of the job)

Build and schedule content calendars in Metricool

Pull weekly performance numbers into a simple standing report

Draft client
s and updates for me to review and send

Keep our ClickUp board clean: tasks tagged, dated, and current

General admin: files, calendars, follow-ups



Tools



Required: Canva, ClickUp, Google Workspace, Metricool

Nice to have: QuickBooks, Meta Business Suite, GoHighLevel



Strong in three of the four required and a fast learner on the fourth? Still apply.



You're a fit if you



Are genuinely fast in Canva and have work to show for it

Are organized to the point that other people's mess bothers you

Write clean, professional English (you'll be drafting client
s)

Ask good questions instead of guessing

Flag problems early instead of hoping they resolve themselves

Want to grow into something bigger



You're not a fit if you



Need step-by-step instructions for every task

Go quiet when something goes wrong

Are looking for a short-term gig while you find something else



Schedule



20 hours per week, Monday to Friday. You choose when you work them, with one requirement: 2 hours of daily overlap from 7pm to 9pm Philippine time so we can actually talk.



Pay and benefits



$450 to $650 USD/month, paid twice monthly via Wise (I cover the transfer fees)

Quarterly performance bonus up to $150

5 paid days off per year after 90 days

Flexibility around major Philippine holidays

All software licensed and paid by us

Compensation review at day 90, then annually



Where this goes



There's a defined path: Operator, then Senior Operator, then Operations Lead. Operations Lead runs the daily execution for our team and helps onboard future hires. Full-time conversion is on the table around the 6 to 12 month mark based on performance, not just time served.



I'd rather pay well and keep someone than churn through people. But I'll be straight with you: advancement is tied to results, and you'll get honest feedback along the way.



How to apply



Start your message with your favorite Canva feature and why you use it. Applications without this get deleted unread.

Link your Canva portfolio, or attach 3 to 5 sample graphics.

In 2 or 3 sentences, tell me about a passion of yours.

Confirm you can work the 7pm to 9pm PHT overlap.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test project before any interview.



Looking forward to reading these.



Carson

title: Real Estate Video Editor
description:
Real Estate Video Editor

Freelance / Gig Work | Remote (Philippines) | Ongoing Projects

Company Type Pay Volume Turnaround First Class Media LLC — New Hampshire, USA

Freelance gig work, paid hourly per project — no fixed schedule, no guaranteed hours

$8 USD/hour, tracked per project; paid biweekly via Wise or Payoneer

Starts around 5–15 hours/week; grows with quality and reliability, busiest

March–October

12 hours from footage handoff to first delivery — this is a hard requirement

About Us

First Class Media is a growing real estate media company serving agents, brokerages, builders, and

property managers across New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island. We shoot listing

photography, video, FAA-licensed drone footage, and 360 tours with a team of field photographers, and we

deliver everything through remote editors.

We're looking for a video editor to take our raw listing footage and turn it into polished walkthrough videos

and social reels. This is project-based work: we send you footage, you send back a finished video within

12 hours, and you bill the hours it took. Editors who are fast, consistent, and easy to work with get first pick

of new projects and more volume over time.

What You'll Do

• Edit 1–3 minute listing walkthrough videos from gimbal, handheld, and drone footage

• Cut 9:16 vertical reels (15–60 seconds) from the same footage for Instagram, TikTok, and

• Color grade and match footage shot on different cameras; apply our LUTs and look

• Stabilize shaky clips, fix exposure, and remove distracting elements where reasonable

• Add licensed music, agent branding, lower thirds, property details, and end cards using our templates

• Follow our style guide: smooth, slow, sequenced room-to-room flow — no flashy transitions or fast cuts

• Deliver in the formats we specify (typically 4K and 1080p horizontal plus vertical exports) to Dropbox

• Keep project files organized and named per our conventions

• Confirm receipt of footage within 1 hour and flag missing shots or problems immediately

• Make one round of revisions per project at no extra charge when they're due to editor error

Who We're Looking For

Required

• 2+ years editing real estate or property videos with a portfolio of at least 3 listing walkthroughs you cut

yourself

• Proficient in DaVinci Resolve (preferred), Final Cut Pro, or Premiere Pro — including color grading, not

just cutting

• Understands real estate pacing and what agents want: clean, bright, and smooth, with the property as

the star

• Comfortable working with drone footage and mixing it with interior clips

• A computer that can handle 4K footage and internet fast enough to download 20–50 GB per project

without delays

• Able to consistently deliver a first cut within 12 hours of receiving footage, and clear English

communication

• Responsive on messages during US Eastern daytime (reply within 1 hour; you will usually receive

footage in the late afternoon or evening Eastern time)

• Willing to track your hours per project accurately

Strongly preferred

• Experience cutting vertical social reels from horizontal footage

• Basic motion graphics (animated titles, property-detail callouts)

• Audio cleanup and music-syncing skills

• HDR real estate photo editing (bracket merging, window pulls) — we have photo work too

• Familiarity with Dropbox and Airtable workflows

Not required: a degree or certification. We care about your reel and your turnaround.

How the Work Runs

• We message you with a project: footage link, property details, agent branding, and deadline

• You confirm and give an ETA the same day

• You deliver a first cut to Dropbox within 12 hours

• We review and send any revisions; you turn those around within 6 hours

• You log your hours for the project; we pay biweekly for all completed work

A standard walkthrough plus one vertical reel should take an experienced editor roughly 2–4 hours. We'll

tell you if a project is unusually large before you start.

Pay & Terms

• $8 USD/hour, billed per project based on tracked hours

• Paid biweekly via Wise or Payoneer for all work delivered in that period

• Your first 3 projects are a paid trial at the same rate; after that, consistent editors get priority on new

work

• Rate reviewed after 6 months of steady work

• Independent contractor arrangement; you're responsible for your own taxes, software licenses, and

equipment

• You'll sign a simple confidentiality and copyright assignment agreement — the finished videos belong to

First Class Media and our clients

How to Apply

Send a message with:

1 Links to 3 real estate walkthrough videos you edited (state which parts you did if it was a team project)

2 One vertical reel if you have one

3 The software you edit and color grade in

4 Confirmation that you can deliver a 2-minute walkthrough within 12 hours, plus your computer/internet

specs

5 Confirmation that $8/hour project-based work fits what you're looking for

6 Put the word "Tuftonboro" in the first line of your message so we know you read the whole posting

Applications without all six items won't be reviewed. Shortlisted editors will receive a short paid test edit

using our real footage.

title: Overseas E-Commerce & Administrative Assistant
description:
About Adorn Croft



Adorn Croft is a dynamic e-commerce furniture and home decor brand specializing in high-quality, customizable furnishings, including our signature modular sofas. We operate globally, managing everything from factory sourcing and product design to international logistics and multi-channel sales, including our website, eBay, and Etsy. We offer bespoke options through our online configurator and are committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience. We are a fast-paced, international team working collaboratively across time zones to bring beautiful, functional designs to our customers.



Role Overview



We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Overseas E-Commerce & Administrative Assistant to support our daily operations. In this role, you will be the backbone of our digital storefront and customer experience, helping ensure that our websites run smoothly, products are accurately and attractively merchandised, and customers receive premium support. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, rendering, logistics, sales, and marketing, while maintaining Adorn Croft's high brand standards.



Key Responsibilities



E-Commerce & Website Management

• Product Listings: Manage and upload new product listings to the main website and a second site currently in development. Ensure accurate pricing, clear and SEO-friendly copy, complete product details, and visually appealing presentation.

• Categorization: Assign products to the correct categories and collections based on site logic, subject to final CEO approval.

• Configurator Backend: Oversee the custom product configurator and coordinate with the IT team and 3D renderer to troubleshoot functionality, update pricing parameters, and accurately upload new digital fabric swatches.

• Site Maintenance: Regularly test the checkout flow, identify glitches, document issues clearly, and follow up with the IT team until fixes are completed fora seamless shopping experience. 

• Google Business Profile: Upload and organize products on the company's Google Business Profile to support local search visibility.



Customer Support & Pipeline Management

• Live Support: Act as the first point of contact during scheduled California afternoon hours, providing excellent customer service by phone and live chat and escalating complex or sensitive matters to the CEO.

• Pipeline Organization: Maintain the customer pipeline database so the sales lead can efficiently follow up with and close warm leads.

• Logistics Coordination: Coordinate with freight and logistics partners to send bi-weekly shipment updates to purchasing customers.

• After-Sales Care: Manage post-delivery communication, including satisfaction follow-ups, review requests, and referral-discount outreach.



Marketing & Social Media Support

• Content Coordination: Collaborate with the social media team through ClickUp to deliver brand assets, content briefs, and creative direction aligned with the company's brand identity.

• Community Engagement: Manage direct messages across social platforms, respond to non-sales inquiries, and help build positive brand relationships.

• Asset Management: Organize and maintain digital asset libraries so brand photos, videos, and supporting materials are easy for the marketing team to locate and use.



Research & Administration

• Market Research: Conduct ongoing competitor research on pricing, services such as white-glove delivery, customer experience, and social media strategies to inform business decisions.

• Logistics Research: Identify and vet suitable local dispatch and delivery companies for the company's delivery network.

• Record Keeping: Maintain accurate internal records of pricing changes, product updates, and operational information using shared Excel files and other company systems.



Requirements

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in e-commerce operations, including product management, website backend administration, customer support, or a closely related function.

• Communication: Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate warmly, clearly, and professionally with customers and internal teams.

• Core Tools: Working proficiency in ClickUp, Gmail, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to learn new systems quickly. Hands-on experience using WordPress for product uploads, page updates, or website administration.

• Brand Awareness: A solid understanding of luxury or high-value product branding and the elevated customer experience it requires.

• Work Style: A proactive mindset and the confidence to identify problems, suggest process improvements, and follow through rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.

• Attention to Detail: A high level of accuracy and strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple moving parts across time zones.

• Availability: Reliable availability during the agreed California afternoon schedule, along with dependable internet access and a professional remote-working environment.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with the furniture, interior design, or home decor industry.

• Basic experience with SEO research or reporting tools such as Ahrefs or Semrush.

• Experience using Canva, photoshop for quick image, presentation, or marketing-asset edits.



First 90 Days: Success Scorecard

During the first 90 days, success in this role will be measured by the following standards:

• 100% assigned products are listed accurately and on schedule, with correct pricing, categories, variants, specifications, imagery, and required website fields.

• CEO messages are acknowledged and responded to within 5 minutes during scheduled working hours, except when actively handling a customer call or another urgent assignment.

• Initial customer chat message response time remains under 2 min during scheduled working hours, with complex matters escalated promptly and clearly. All customer

title: Performance Marketing Operator - Google + Meta (NOT a VA role)
description:
READ THIS FIRST. This is not a virtual assistant role and not an ads-assistant role. We are hiring one person to run paid advertising for two dental practices in Canada and to own the result. If your experience is scheduling posts, building reports someone else reads, or assisting a media buyer, this is not for you and we will not reply.



Applications that do not include all three items listed under HOW TO APPLY get deleted unread.



HOURS

Work your own daytime hours. We are in Canada on Pacific time and we do not need you awake at night. A normal Manila schedule already lines up well: our advertising day finishes at 3:00 PM your time, so you review a complete day and set up the next one before ours begins.



What we do require:

- Your daily review is finished and posted by 6:00 AM Pacific (9:00 PM Manila).

- Any message answered within 12 hours, and within 2 hours during your own working day.

- Available for an occasional scheduled call at 8:00-9:00 AM Pacific (11:00 PM Manila) when we ask.

- If you see money running to something broken, you pause it immediately without asking permission.



THE BUSINESS

Two dental practices in British Columbia, Canada, sharing one set of ad accounts. One is a general practice where every single booking arrives by telephone. The other is a full-arch dental implant brand where one case is worth about $49,000 and patients fly in from three provinces. We spend roughly $10,000 to $20,000 USD a month across Google Search and Meta, with room to grow.



THE NUMBER YOU OWN

Net new patients per month, counted in our practice management software. Not leads. Not platform conversions. Not clicks. Alongside it, cost per booked and attended patient. Those are the two numbers you are reviewed on, every month.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Run both accounts every day - budgets, keywords, negatives, match types, audiences, creative tests, landing pages and offers. Treat the two practices as two different businesses; a campaign selling a $49,000 case is not run or judged like one selling a cleaning. Own the follow-up sequence for high-value leads. Keep the measurement honest - call tracking, offline conversion imports, CRM hygiene - and tell us the same day when a number cannot be trusted. Write three lines at the end of each day on what you changed and what is blocking you, and a real written summary every Friday. We do not hold meetings. Everything is written.



WHAT WE ALREADY HAVE

Tracked phone numbers for each ad source, a ledger recording every form, call, message and booking, a daily per-ad report, and automatic alerts when something stops running. You are not building any of it. What is missing is a person who reads it every day and acts on it before the owner notices - the starved campaign, the competitor's name costing $30 a click, the landing page with no tracking on it.



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You have personally managed at least $50,000 USD a month across Google Search and Meta.

- You did it for local service businesses where the sale is closed on the phone - dental, medical spa, cosmetic surgery, legal, home services. Not e-commerce.

- You have handled at least one high-value offer where the customer takes months to d
.

- You can explain, without being asked, the difference between impression share lost to budget and impression share lost to rank.

- You have worked with call tracking, offline conversion imports, and a CRM as the source of truth. GoHighLevel is a plus.



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

- You report CTR, cost per click or platform conversions as your results.

- Your background is agency account management rather than owning an outcome.

- You need a developer to change a landing page URL.



HOW TO APPLY

Do not send a resume, a portfolio, or a cover letter. We will not read them. Three things:



1. Your subject line must read exactly: IMPRESSION SHARE - [your full name]



2. A link to a 3-minute screen recording, unedited. Share your screen inside a Google Ads or Meta account you personally managed. Hide the client name, we do not need it. Show us the account, its monthly spend and its conversion column; the search terms report or the ad set breakdown; and one change you made and why, pointing at it on screen. Talk over it. Rough is fine. A phone recording of your monitor is fine. No editing and no slides. If you have really run accounts, this takes you five minutes. Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube are all fine.



3. One line: what you need to be paid per month, and why that number.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Shortlisted applicants get a paid three-day trial with read-only access to our two real ad accounts. You give us one page per practice: what is wrong with it, and a 30-day plan with a target cost per booked patient. It must begin with three specific numbers that you pull yourself, which we name when we give you access. Finalists do one 45-minute session with the owner, screen shared, live in our account. That is the only meeting in the whole job.



You may use AI for any part of this. We do. We are hiring someone who can operate, not someone who can write.

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
About the Role

GigLogic is a growing music-industry technology company built for working performers.

We’re looking for a full-time Social Media & Content Manager who is unusually good at finding stories, developing ideas, and turning raw material into compelling social content.

This is not a Virtual Assistant position.

And it is not primarily a job for someone who waits for us to provide finished content and then schedules it.

We need someone who thinks.

Our founder generates a lot of raw material: stories, videos, interviews, podcasts, articles, press, performance footage, industry insights, product demonstrations, photographs, opinions, and ideas.



Your job is to look at that material and think:

“There’s a story here.”

“That’s the hook.”

“This should be a Reel, not a graphic.”

“We can get five pieces of content from this conversation.”

“Craig should record something about this.”

Or, best of all:

“I have an idea.”



What You’ll Do

You’ll take ownership of GigLogic’s day-to-day social media and content presence, including:

·       Developing original content ideas

·       Identifying stories and opportunities in existing material

·       Creating and maintaining a thoughtful content calendar

·       Writing captions, hooks, posts, and social copy

·       Editing short-form video

·       Creating graphics and carousels

·       Repurposing podcasts, interviews, articles, and videos into multiple pieces of content

·       Publishing and scheduling content

·       Helping manage social engagement and community interaction

·       Watching trends without blindly chasing them

·       Reviewing performance and identifying what’s working

·       Recommending what we should do more of, less of, or differently

·       Proactively asking for the raw material you need

·       Bringing new ideas to us rather than waiting for us to bring every idea to you



Who We’re Looking For

You should be:

·       An excellent English communicator, both written and spoken

·       A strong writer

·       A creative and strategic thinker

·       Comfortable editing short-form video

·       Visually capable with tools such as Canva

·       Curious and interested in understanding the ideas behind a business

·       Organized, dependable, and able to work independently

·       Comfortable offering your opinion — even when you disagree with the founder

·       Someone who notices opportunities other people miss

Professional social media or content experience is important.

Experience in music or entertainment is helpful, but not required.

We would rather hire an exceptional content thinker who can learn our industry than an industry expert who cannot tell a great story.



About GigLogic

GigLogic helps working performers understand what a professional opportunity will actually pay them before they say yes.

The fee for a gig is not necessarily what the performer takes home.

Travel, musicians, crew, production, commissions, taxes, lodging, and other expenses can dramatically change the real financial value of an opportunity.

That’s why one of our core beliefs is:

The paycheck isn’t the profit.

GigLogic gives performers the information they need to make smarter professional decisions and build more sustainable careers.



Compensation & Commitment

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.

Starting salary: $1,000 USD per month.

We are open to hearing from exceptional candidates whose compensation expectations differ, and the application will give you an opportunity to tell us what you would require.



Working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.



Because this role works closely with our founder throughout the day, you must be comfortable consistently working this schedule from the Philippines.



This is intended to be your primary full-time professional commitment. We are looking for someone who can dedicate their scheduled working hours to GigLogic rather than dividing that time among multiple clients or employers.



We are also looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, not a short freelance project or temporary assignment.



How to Apply

Please complete our application here:



We care much more about your actual work, judgment, communication, and ideas than about degrees or impressive job titles.

Please read the application carefully and answer the questions yourself.

We want to hear your voice, not what you think the perfect applicant is supposed to say.

One important detail: When you reach the final question in the application, begin your answer with the word GIG.



***NOTE: Applications that simply send a résumé or generic message through OnlineJobs.ph without completing the application will not be considered.***



If this sounds like the kind of role where you’d do your best work, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Trademark Specialist / Trademark Paralegal - Remote
description:
We are looking for an experienced trademark professional to join a remote team handling a wide variety of trademark matters throughout the full lifecycle of a trademark.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on trademark experience who can review files, identify required actions, prepare substantive work, and help move matters forward with limited supervision.



The majority of the work involves U.S. trademarks, with additional international trademark work across several other major jurisdictions.



## Responsibilities



Depending on your experience, work may include:



- Trademark clearance searches and registrability assessments

- Preparing trademark applications and goods/services descriptions

- Reviewing trademark office correspondence and identifying required actions

- Preparing responses to Office Actions

- Handling identification amendments, disclaimers, specimen issues, domicile issues, and other prosecution matters

- Managing intent-to-use applications, Statements of Use, extensions, and related deadlines

- Reviewing and preparing maintenance and renewal filings

- Monitoring application and registration status

- Assisting with opposition and cancellation matters

- Assisting with coexistence, consent, and settlement matters

- Preparing assignments and ownership changes

- Managing trademark portfolios and docketing deadlines

- Reviewing foreign trademark correspondence

- Coordinating matters across multiple jurisdictions

- Drafting clear client and attorney correspondence

- Improving internal trademark workflows, templates, and processes



## What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate has meaningful professional experience working with trademarks and understands how matters progress from clearance and filing through prosecution, registration, maintenance, enforcement, and disputes.



Strong U.S. trademark experience is particularly important.



You should be comfortable with matters involving:



- Trademark applications and prosecution

- Office Actions and examiner correspondence

- Likelihood of confusion refusals

- Descriptiveness refusals

- Intent-to-use applications

- Statements of Use and extension requests

- Foreign-basis applications

- Specimens and use-in-commerce requirements

- Trademark deadlines and docketing

- Opposition and cancellation proceedings



Experience with trademark systems outside the U.S. is a strong advantage.



## Requirements



- Prior professional trademark experience

- Excellent written English

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to identify deadlines and procedural requirements accurately

- Ability to research trademark issues independently

- Good judgment when reviewing client files

- Comfortable managing multiple matters at once

- Reliable internet connection

- Interest in ongoing remote work



A law degree or attorney qualification is not required. Practical trademark experience is more important.



## Compensation



USD $8-$15/hour depending on experience, capabilities, and fit.



We are looking for someone interested in ongoing work who can take on increasing responsibility over time.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short summary of your trademark experience

2. The jurisdictions you have worked with

3. The types of trademark matters you have personally handled

4. Your current availability

5. Your expected hourly rate



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a brief trademark skills assessment before an interview.

title: Part Time Social Media Content Producer and Video Editor for a Tiny Chihuahua with a BIG Personality!
description:
We are building the social media presence of **Frijolito Bandito Alejandro Cilantro Chavez Johnson**, also known as Bean.



Frijolito is a tiny Chihuahua living in Mérida, Mexico. He has a distinct personality, an unusual rescue story and a growing English and Spanish-speaking audience. His content is funny, clever, slightly inappropriate, warm and never generic. Think tiny international celebrity with questionable judgment.



I am looking for someone who can take raw photos, videos and instructions and turn them into polished social media content for
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



This is not a position for someone who needs to be taught basic editing, social media formatting or how to use creative software. I can provide the necessary software, but you must already know how to do the work.



## What You Will Do



* Organize raw photos and video clips

* Edit short-form videos and Reels

* Edit photos naturally and professionally

* Remove people, hands or distracting objects when instructed

* Preserve Frijolito’s real appearance

* Add captions, sound effects, music, voiceovers and graphics

* Create bilingual English and natural Mexican Spanish content

* Format content correctly for each social media platform

* Follow written instructions and brand guidelines

* Submit every piece of content for approval

* Make requested revisions quickly and accurately

* Schedule or publish content only after receiving written approval

* Maintain an organized content calendar and file system



## Non-Negotiable Requirements



You must:



* Have strong short-form video editing skills

* Be experienced with CapCut, Canva or comparable software

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Follow instructions exactly

* Listen carefully and apply feedback the first time

* Be comfortable receiving very direct feedback

* Meet deadlines without repeated reminders

* Communicate clearly when you have a legitimate question

* Never post anything without my approval

* Never change Frijolito’s appearance, coloring, size or facial features unless specifically instructed

* Understand that this brand already has a voice and personality

* Be able to reproduce that voice consistently instead of replacing it with your own

* Keep all photos, videos, drafts and account information completely confidential



I have a short temperament for repeated mistakes, ignored instructions and sloppy work. I am direct, decisive and very clear about what I want. I do not expect perfection without feedback, but I do expect you to listen, execute and avoid making the same mistake twice.



If you need constant supervision, extensive training or repeated explanations, this will not be a good fit.



If you are talented, organized, reliable and enjoy clear direction, this could become a fun and steady long-term position.



## The Right Person



The right person understands that funny pet content is still brand content. You should have good comedic timing and know how to make a video entertaining without drowning it in effects, stickers or trendy nonsense.



You should be able to learn Frijolito’s personality and understand the difference between:



* Clever and corny

* Funny and obnoxious

* Professionally edited and obviously overedited

* Natural Spanish and computer-generated Spanish

* Making a suggestion and ignoring instructions



Spanish fluency, particularly Mexican Spanish, is highly preferred. Strong English is required.



## Hours and Working Arrangement



* Part-time to begin

* Approximately 10 to 15 hours per week

* Remote

* Flexible working hours, but reliable communication and turnaround times are required

* Long-term opportunity for the right person

* Paid trial project required before hiring



I will provide the raw content, creative direction, account access needed for the position and paid software when appropriate.



## Paid Trial Project



Final candidates will receive the same small paid project consisting of photos, video clips and detailed instructions.



You will be asked to create:



* One short-form video

* One edited photo

* One completed social media post package



The test is designed to evaluate your editing ability, organization, judgment, communication and, most importantly, your ability to follow instructions.



## How to Apply



Begin your application with:



**BEAN MEANS BUSINESS**



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be reviewed.



Please include:



1. A short introduction written specifically for this position

2. Your hourly rate in USD

3. Your weekly availability

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 15 to 30-second Reel

5. The software you use for photo and video editing

6. Your experience creating short-form social media content

7. Whether you speak or write Spanish, including your level of fluency

8. Three examples of your best short-form videos

9. Two examples of photo-editing work

10. A description of how you handle direct feedback and revisions

11. Confirmation that you understand nothing may be posted without written approval

12. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid trial project



Do not send a generic application or a long list of unrelated services. I want to see relevant work and evidence that you read this entire posting.



Tell me why you believe you can understand Frijolito’s personality, follow an established creative direction and help turn him into a recognizable international pet brand.



If you are creative, fast, skilled and capable of listening before editing, I want to hear from you.



## Compensation



* Starting rate: **$6 USD per hour**

* Approximately **10 to 15 hours per week**

* Paid trial project: **$25 USD**

* 30-day trial period

* Rate may increase to **$7 to $8 USD per hour** after the trial period based on editing quality, reliability, speed and ability to follow instructions

* This is intended to become a steady, long-term position for the right person

title: Video Editor for Sheet Metal How-To YouTube Channel (Long-term, Ongoing)
description:
I run an educational YouTube channel about architectural sheet metal and metal roofing. It has been going since 2020 and the audience is tradespeople and homeowners who are trying to do the job properly.



The core of the channel is evergreen how-to content - "how to install X" videos that people find by searching for a problem they have in front of them right now. That is the work I care most about and it is where most of your edits will be.



Each month I need three long-form videos, usually eight to fifteen minutes finished, plus three or four Shorts cut from the same footage. I film on Sunday evenings and will drop the footage into a shared Google Drive folder with a short brief, that night or Monday morning. I need the first cut back in the same folder within four days. Two rounds of revisions are included per video, and I will send notes with timestamps so you are never guessing what I mean. I publish most weeks but I plan deliberate off-weeks, so the schedule is three per month rather than one every single week.



The editing style is simple and I want to keep it that way. Straight cuts, cut the dead air and the flubs, clean audio, and basic text overlays where I name a tool or a measurement. No heavy motion graphics and no fast trendy jump-cut style. What matters in a how-to is that the viewer can see what my hands are doing, so hold on the detail shots rather than cutting away from them, and stay wide enough that the work is readable.



Edit in whatever software you prefer - Premiere, DaVinci, CapCut, it makes no difference to me. Deliver 1080p H.264. The source footage will already be compressed to keep the Drive transfers manageable, so please go easy on the export settings rather than squeezing it again.



This is ongoing work, not a one-off project. 25 to 30 USD per long-form video and 5 USD per Short, paid monthly through Wise. The channel funds this entirely out of its own ad revenue, so I am being straight with you about the budget. My goal over the next twelve months is to grow that revenue roughly five times over, and the extra output is a big part of how I get there. As it grows I will raise your rate, and I would much rather do that with the person who helped build it than go looking for someone new.



To apply, send me links to two or three edits you have done, ideally instructional or talking-head work rather than vlogs or weddings. Tell me in one line what you would cut from a ten-minute how-to to make it eight. Put the word FLASHING at the top of your reply so I know you read this properly.

description:

 Phone +

 Flexible VA” energy

4. Records, Research & Client Communication

title: Shopify Store Ops + Customer Desk (Night Shift ET)
description:
Cowhides Direct sells one-of-a-kind cowhide rugs. Every hide is photographed in our Florida studio. The hide in the photo is the hide that ships  that promise is the whole business. Warehouse in Palm Beach Gardens. Since 1998. We answer the phone.



This seat is Shopify store ops plus the customer desk — not a department head, not a pure ticket agent.



You will work inside Shopify and our customer inbox on the same night shift. Store side: order breaks, address and fulfillment edge cases, catalog/photo-promise hygiene, notes that keep unique SKUs honest, light admin that unsticks an order. Desk side: phone,
, and chat when the case is messy — dig, d
, finish, document. Automation handles more routine questions over time; you own what still needs a human who understands both the store and the customer.



If you have run Shopify for a brand where the unit on the page is the unit that ships (handmade, furniture, rugs, vintage, one-of-ones) and you still take customer contacts, keep reading. If you only want to “manage the CS team” or you only close tickets with a script, stop here.



PAY

$1,300–$1,600 USD per month · full-time · 40 hours · long-term



THE SHIFT (read twice)

• 9:00am–5:00pm Eastern / 9:00pm–5:00am Philippines

• Eight-hour shifts. 40 hours. Weekends as assigned.

• Night shift covering US daytime. Daytime Philippines hours = wrong post.

• Attendance tracked (Insightful). Cameras on for training gates.

• First seven calendar days = paid training, earned only by completing every scheduled 8-hour shift. Miss or leave early without notice before start  engagement ends that day.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

• Shopify muscle memory: order states, unfulfilled vs fulfilled, address changes, cancels, partial paths, clean internal notes.

 Protect the photo-is-promise: never treat a one-of-a-kind hide like a color swatch SKU; ask before you recommend; check history before you speak.

• Phone + inbox for exceptions: tracking conflicts, folded-on-arrival, missing gifts, return-to-sender, “is this the exact hide.

• Same break twice → write the checklist/SOP so store ops and CX stop recreating it.

• English we can send unedited. Read-back every number. Notes with goal, promise, deadline.



WHO THIS IS FOR

• 2+ years hands-on Shopify e-com support or store ops (not “I used Shopify once”).

• Unique-SKU / made-to-order / high-consideration products preferred.

 You can show one store/ops break you fixed and one customer case you closed with root cause + what you changed afterward.

• You are willing to take phone work — player, not “head of CX.”

• Quiet room, computer, stable internet, backup power or backup internet, speed-test screenshot.

• Exact night-shift commitment. No overlapping full-time job on the same hours.



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

• Script BPO / AHT heroes / escalate-everything

 People who want a manager title with no queue and no Shopify admin

 Pure marketers, VA generalists, or template/AI applications

• Part-time-only vs 8-hour tracked night seat



HOW TO APPLY

Skip any item → closed unread.



1) First word: GRAINLOT

Then why THIS night shift works for your life right now.



2) Shopify break you owned: One order, catalog, fulfillment, or admin mess you fixed. What was wrong in the store? What did you change?



3) Customer case you closed: What did you open first? Root cause? What did you change so it would not repeat?



4) No-notice misses in the last 24 months — count and what happened.



Attach: speed-test screenshot · backup power/internet · resume · PH hours you can work.



No 9:00pm–5:00am Philippines → do not apply.



Long-term seat. Store truth + customer finish.



Jason H

Cowhides Direct

Most of the editing will be relatively simple: combining images, clips, text and compositions in a visually interesting way.



Main style reference:

• Promotion: Transition to a fixed Full-Time role is a mandatory and inevitable process for candidates who demonstrate zero operational errors, strong discipline, and high reliability.

• Regular Salary: USD 400 - $450/month base salary.

• Bonuses: Eligible for a USD 35 Monthly Full-Attendance Bonus and potential promotion to Shift Leader (up to USD 500/month).



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Relevant Experience Highly Preferred: At least 2 years of highly relevant experience in BPO, fintech, payments, e-commerce, banking, or complex chat support. You must be comfortable working with numbers, screenshots, and system records.

• Strong written English and fast, accurate typing.

• Ability to strictly follow SOPs with zero deviation.

• A reliable PC/laptop (mobile-only work is NOT accepted), stable internet, and a power backup plan.



OUR ZERO-TOLERANCE POLICY (Strict Standards)

We maintain strict operational standards to protect our business. This role is NOT for you if:

• You are a freelancer or hold other active VA jobs (We require dedicated focus leading to your full-time regularization).

PAYJN

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER / B2B SALES EXECUTIVE Low-Voltage Telecommunications, Technical Field Services and Staffing
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER / B2B SALES EXECUTIVE

Low-Voltage Telecommunications, Technical Field Services and Staffing



Company: Integrated Staffing

Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Full-Time

Required Availability: U.S. Eastern Time

Compensation: Paid Introductory Period + Base Salary + Uncapped Commission



ABOUT INTEGRATED STAFFING



Integrated Staffing supports U.S.-based clients with staffing and project-delivery solutions for low-voltage telecommunications, structured cabling, fiber, access control, Wi-Fi, networking, technical infrastructure and field services.



We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager who can identify, pursue and close profitable business with U.S.-based organizations.



This is not a passive lead-generation or administrative sales-support position. The successful candidate must actively find decision-makers, initiate conversations, qualify opportunities, conduct discovery calls, follow up consistently and help convert qualified opportunities into signed, profitable agreements.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Prospecting and Pipeline Development



* Identify U.S.-based companies that need low-voltage, telecommunications, network-infrastructure, field-service or staffing support.

* Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, industry directories, procurement portals, referrals, professional associations and online research.

* Conduct outbound prospecting through telephone calls,
, LinkedIn and other approved channels.

* Identify and contact decision-makers in operations, facilities, information technology, construction, procurement, project management and vendor management.

* Develop relationships with direct clients, general contractors, technology integrators, manufacturers, healthcare organizations, data centers, logistics companies, retailers and other qualified organizations.

* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospects, qualified opportunities, proposals and follow-up activities.

* Re-engage previous and inactive clients when authorized.



Discovery and Qualification



* Conduct professional discovery calls with U.S.-based prospects.

* Understand the client’s technical requirements, locations, schedule, budget, decision process and purchasing requirements.

* Determine whether opportunities align with the company’s capabilities, pricing and risk standards.

* Identify whether an opportunity involves direct project work, staffing, project delivery or another service model.

* Recognize unprofitable, poorly defined or excessively risky opportunities.

* Collect the information necessary for leadership to make an informed bid-or-no-bid decision.

* Verify decision-makers, purchasing authority, expected timelines and next steps.

* Assess potential clients for payment risk, contract requirements and long-term value.



Sales and Closing



* Present Integrated Staffing’s capabilities professionally and accurately.

* Coordinate technical discussions with operations and project-management personnel.

* Prepare or assist with proposals, presentations, capability statements and follow-up materials.

* Maintain consistent follow-up throughout long sales cycles.

* Address objections and explain the value of the company’s services.

* Support contract discussions while ensuring all pricing and terms receive proper approval.

* Move qualified prospects toward signed agreements and active projects.

* Never make unauthorized promises concerning pricing, staffing, schedules, credit terms, technical capabilities or contractual obligations.

* Never approve contracts, discounts, purchases or pricing without authorization.



Client Development and Retention



* Maintain regular communication with new and existing clients.

* Support a professional transition from sales into project delivery.

* Remain involved after the sale to confirm that expectations are being met.

* Identify additional locations, departments, services and future opportunities.

* Work with project management to address concerns before they damage the client relationship.

* Help turn successful initial projects into repeat business and long-term accounts.

* Maintain accurate records of client commitments, preferences and future needs.

* Conduct structured post-project follow-up to identify additional opportunities.



TECHNICAL UNDERSTANDING



Candidates should understand:



* Low-voltage telecommunications

* Structured cabling

* Cat5e, Cat6 and Cat6A cabling

* Fiber-optic cabling

* Network switches and routers

* Wireless access points

* Racks, cabinets and patch panels

* MDF and IDF telecommunications rooms

* Access-control systems

* Network-infrastructure deployments

* Technical field-service work

* Site surveys

* Bills of materials

* Statements of work

* Technician qualifications and certifications



The salesperson is not expected to engineer or program systems. However, the person must understand the services well enough to ask appropriate questions, accurately represent company capabilities and avoid selling work that cannot be delivered safely or profitably.



CRM AND REPORTING



The Business Development Manager must maintain complete and accurate CRM records, including:



* Prospect and company name

* Decision-maker and contact information

* Lead source

* Services needed

* Estimated opportunity value

* Expected gross margin

* Last contact and next action

* Proposal and contract status

* Probability of closing

* Expected decision date

* Reasons opportunities were won or lost



Weekly reporting must include:



* Outbound calls,
s and LinkedIn outreach

* New decision-makers contacted

* Conversations completed

* Qualified discovery meetings

* New opportunities created

* Proposals submitted

* Estimated pipeline value

* Agreements signed

* Collected revenue and gross profit

* Stalled opportunities and recommended actions

* Client-retention and expansion activity



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



*Must have previous experience bidding government telecommunications projects and must have awarded contracts   

*At least three years of successful B2B sales or business-development experience

* Experience prospecting and selling to U.S.-based companies

* Demonstrated ability to find prospects rather than relying exclusively on inbound leads

* Experience conducting discovery calls, presenting services and closing business

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confident and professional telephone communication

* Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills

* Experience using a CRM

* Ability to manage a long and complex sales process

* Strong judgment concerning client quality, risk and profitability

* Ability to work independently and remain productive without constant supervision

* Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours

* Reliable high-speed internet, computer, headset and quiet professional workspace



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience selling low-voltage, telecommunications, structured-cabling, fiber, networking, access-control, IT-infrastructure or technical field services

* Experience selling staffing, recruiting or project-based services

* Existing relationships with U.S. contractors, integrators, manufacturers, facilities teams or procurement departments

* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or another CRM

* Experience responding to RFPs, vendor-registration opportunities or procurement requests

* Experience selling services with project values exceeding $1,000,000

* Proven history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

* Experience expanding small accounts into long-term client relationships



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success will be measured by:



* Quality and accuracy of targeted prospect lists

* Consistent outbound prospecting

* Conversations with appropriate decision-makers

* Qualified discovery meetings

* Legitimate opportunities created

* Pipeline quality and estimated value

* Proposal-to-close conversion rate

* New clients acquired

* Collected sales

* Collected gross profit

* Contract quality and payment terms

* Client retention and repeat business

* CRM accuracy and follow-up consistency



The long-term objective is to help build a sales pipeline capable of producing at least $2 million in annual collected revenue while maintaining approved profitability and risk standards.



COMPENSATION AND PAID INTRODUCTORY PERIOD



This position begins with a 60-day paid introductory period.



During the introductory period:



* Base compensation depending on experience 

* Uncapped commission eligibility from the first day

* Leads provided

* Clear weekly activity, pipeline and reporting expectations



After successful completion of the 60-day introductory period:



* Base salary will increase based on experience and progression 

*A full time assistant will be provided 

* Uncapped commission will continue

* Additional bonuses may be available for exceeding quarterly collected-sales and gross-profit targets

* Long-term growth opportunities may include Senior Business Development Manager or Sales Director responsibilities

*Possibility of travel to the USA to meet the team

Commission is based on collected gross profit from qualified business personally originated by the salesperson. Commission is earned only after the client has paid and the associated direct project costs have been recorded.



The specific commission percentage, eligibility period and payment schedule will be included in the written compensation agreement.



INTRODUCTORY-PERIOD EVALUATION



The salesperson will not be evaluated solely on closed revenue during the introductory period because complex B2B sales may require a longer sales cycle.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Understanding of the company’s services and ideal clients

* Quality and accuracy of target prospect lists

* Consistent outbound calls,
s and LinkedIn outreach

* Conversations with appropriate U.S.-based decision-makers

* Qualified discovery meetings scheduled and completed

* Legitimate opportunities added to the CRM

* Estimated pipeline value and gross-profit potential

* Quality of discovery notes and follow-up

* Proposals or pricing opportunities developed

* Accuracy and consistency of CRM records

* Professional communication and reliability

* Ability to identify and reject unqualified or excessively risky opportunities



Continuation after the introductory period is not automatic. The salesperson must demonstrate consistent effort, sound judgment, professional communication and the ability to build a credible pipeline of profitable opportunities.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word “PIPELINE” to confirm that you read the complete posting.



Please provide:



1. Your current résumé

2. Your experience selling to U.S.-based businesses

3. The products or services you have sold

4. Your average sale size and sales-cycle length

5. Your individual sales targets and actual results

6. Your largest personally originated and closed account

7. An example of a client you found through cold prospecting

8. Your experience with low-voltage, telecommunications, networking, field services or staffing

9. The prospecting and CRM tools you have used

10. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

11. A short voice or video introduction demonstrating your spoken English

12. Two professional references who can verify your sales results



Applicants whose experience is limited to data entry, customer service, social-media posting or appointment setting without responsibility for developing and closing B2B opportunities will not be considered.

About the Role

We are a fast-growing sports media brand living and breathing football (soccer) culture. As we expand our marketing strategy across social media and YouTube, we are looking for two skilled Multimedia Editors specializing in both short-form and long-form content to scale our production capacity.



In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-retention TikToks, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, as well as editing polished, engaging long-form YouTube videos (documentaries, listicles, match breakdowns, and video podcasts). If you understand football culture, master pacing across different video formats, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Production: Edit fast-paced, high-retention short-form videos (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) utilizing strong hooks, trending sounds, dynamic text overlays, motion graphics, and sound effects.



Long-Form Video Editing: Structure and edit compelling long-form YouTube videos (e.g., mini-documentaries, narrative breakdowns, tactical analysis, listicles), maintaining strong viewer retention and narrative flow.



Football Culture & Trend Integration: Seamlessly incorporate match footage, statistics, memes, news clips, sound effects, and culturally relevant football banter into edits.



Thumbnail & Graphic Assets: Create or assist with high-CTR thumbnails and visual assets tailored for long-form YouTube and short-form platforms.



Fast-Turnaround News Edits: Rapidly edit quick-reaction content to capitalize on breaking news, viral matchday moments, and trending football topics.



Platform Optimization: Tailor edits to platform-specific specs (aspect ratios, pacing, safe zones, hooks, and retention strategies).



Team Collaboration: Work closely with our Marketing Strategist via ClickUp to manage video pipelines, revisions, and release schedules efficiently.



Qualifications & Requirements

Format Expertise: Proven specialization in editing both short-form (vertical 9:16) and long-form (horizontal 16:9) videos with high viewer retention rates.



Niche Passion & Knowledge: Deep understanding of global football (leagues, teams, players, tactical narratives, and social media football culture/memes).



Software Proficiency: Expert command of Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. Strong skills in After Effects (motion graphics, animated lower-thirds, tracking) and CapCut are highly preferred.



Portfolio / Showreel: Must submit a portfolio featuring examples of both short-form and long-form football/sports edits demonstrating strong pacing, audio design, and narrative flow.



Speed & Reliability: Ability to deliver polished edits on schedule during tight deadlines and fast-moving matchdays.



Full-Time Focus: Ability to dedicate 100% of your professional focus to this role (strictly no freelancing, side gigs, or second jobs).



Schedule Alignment: Able to consistently work 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT, Monday to Friday.



Remote Work Setup: High-performance editing rig, fast internet connection, and proficiency with remote tools like ClickUp.



What We Offer

Salary: ?27,000 – ?30,000 / month



Growth Potential: Opportunity to advance into a Lead Multimedia Editor or Creative Producer role as our media outlet grows.



100% remote working setup.



Work directly on exciting content within the global sports media ecosystem.



Collaborative, fast-paced, and passionate team culture.

About Beanstalk Single Mums:

Beanstalk Single Mums is a leading Australian digital platform, community, and podcast (Real Talk for Single Mums) dedicated to empowering single mothers. We connect an engaged audience of over 77,000 mums with practical resources, expert guidance, and vetted, ethical brand partners.



Position Overview:

We are seeking an ambitious, proactive, and commercially savvy Content Collaboration Coordinator to take full ownership of our inbox management, brand partnerships, and article publishing workflow.



You will not just manage inbound requests—you will actively drive outbound opportunities. When the inbox is quiet, you will proactively prospect and pitch reputable, family-aligned brands for podcast sponsorships, guest articles, and directory features. Additionally, you will format, optimize, and schedule incoming articles directly inside WordPress.



Key Responsibilities:



Inbound Inbox Triage & Commercial Gatekeeping: Monitor and organize the inbox daily. Categorize pitches, respond with our Media Kit/Rate Cards, decline low-paying affiliate or gifted-product offers politely, and negotiate placement packages.



Proactive Outbound Outreach: Actively research, identify, and cold-pitch reputable brands, PR agencies, and potential podcast guests that align with our single-mum ethos (family tech, finance, legal, parenting essentials).



End-to-End Podcast Coordination: Manage guest booking, coordinate recording schedules across Australian (AEST) and international time zones, collect bios/headshots, and distribute promotional assets after episodes go live.



WordPress Formatting & Scheduling: Upload and stage approved guest articles directly into WordPress. Format headers, style pull-quotes, insert images, check links, and configure basic on-page SEO (meta descriptions, focus keywords, alt text).



Affiliate & Link Auditing: Keep track of live partner links and affiliate assets to ensure URLs remain active and tracking properly.



Non-Negotiable Requirements:



Flawless Written English: Exceptional writing ability with a warm, natural tone suitable for parenting audiences, paired with polished assertiveness when negotiating with corporate brands.



Proven Outreach & Pitching Experience: Comfortable finding brand decision-maker contacts and sending compelling cold/warm collaboration pitches.



WordPress & SEO Savvy: Hands-on experience formatting blog posts in WordPress (Gutenberg or Classic editor) and applying standard on-page SEO best practices (e.g., Yoast or Rank Math).



Time Zone Accuracy: Flawless scheduling across Australian time zones (AEST/AEDT) and overseas zones without confusion.



High Attention to Detail: Ability to spot broken links, maintain spreadsheet trackers, and follow editorial guidelines without oversight.

title: Marketing Operations Assistant (GoHighLevel) — Full-Time, Long-Term, US Company
description:
WHO WE ARE



The Wealth Creation Club helps people in the United States learn about real estate investing, and find reputable education, events and resources that fit their goals.



Our members pay us nothing to take part. We earn our revenue through referral partnerships with established real estate education companies, when someone we have referred chooses to become their customer. We would rather tell you that plainly now than have you wonder later.



TWCC is a new venture from the owner of Seattle Nanny Network — a US company that has been trading since 1997, has won Better Business Bureau awards in 2003 and 2021, and has been written about in the New York Times, Axios, The Cut and the Seattle Times.



Please do look us up before you apply:

   

   
/in/emily-dills-0b396b111



We would much rather you applied knowing exactly who we are.



We are at the point where the platform is nearly built and needs someone to run the marketing side of it properly. That is the job.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO



- Own the content calendar. Know what is going out, when, and on which channel.

- Write and schedule
 and SMS campaigns in GoHighLevel.

- Watch what is happening inside our community and turn it into announcements that go out to our leads.

- Repurpose approved content across channels so one good piece of work does several jobs.

- Keep the CRM tidy — contacts, tags, and lists that can be trusted.

- Write down how you did things, so the next person does not have to guess.



You will not be talking to clients or job applicants. This is behind-the-scenes work.



You do NOT need to know anything about real estate investing. You do need to be willing to learn enough about it to write clearly on the subject. We will teach you the rest.



WHAT WE ARE ACTUALLY LOOKING FOR



Here is the honest description, in our own words. The person we are hoping to find is responsive and communicative, does high-quality work, is smart and self-driven, and has a "figure it out" personality.



We would rather have someone curious and resourceful who learns fast than someone who has used every tool before but waits to be told what to do.



You do NOT need years of GoHighLevel experience. If you have never opened it but you are the kind of person who will find the documentation, watch the videos and work it out, that counts for more with us.



What we do need:

- Genuinely good written English. You will be writing things our leads read.

- Real organisation. Things do not get forgotten because nobody reminded you.

- Comfort with AI tools. We use them, we expect you to use them, and we will ask you how.

- Follow-through. You close the loop without being chased.

- Honesty about what you do not know.



HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



We use Hubstaff for time tracking, and we will be straight with you about why. We are a small team, you will be working while we are asleep, and it lets us pay you promptly and with confidence.



Our intention is to stop needing it after your 90-day review. If the work speaks for itself, it should. We would genuinely rather not be looking over anyone's shoulder.



You will also send a short end-of-day note: what you did, anything you are stuck on, anything you need from us. It takes five minutes and it prevents almost every problem a remote team has.



THE HOURS — PLEASE READ THIS PART



Your day starts at 7:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday, 40 hours a week.



That gives you one to two hours of overlap with our late afternoon in Seattle for a short daily check-in, and the rest of your day is your own to get on with the work.



This is NOT a graveyard shift. You keep normal Philippine daytime hours. We know how rare that is for US-facing work and we did it on purpose.



Expected start: early October 2026.



WHAT WE PAY, AND WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



$750 USD per month to start, paid bi-weekly.

$800 USD per month once you pass your 90-day review. That is written into your agreement — it is not something you have to ask for.



Beyond that: this role is meant to grow. As TWCC grows, a person who becomes fully independent in this seat can realistically expect to roughly double their starting salary within the first year, plus a bonus structure we will discuss with you. We are telling you that as an honest intention rather than a guarantee, because it depends on the business hitting its targets — and you would be part of making that happen.



Other terms, stated up front so nobody has to negotiate later:

- Philippine public holidays, paid.

- 10 days paid leave per year, accruing.

- 90-day probation with a written review at the end. If you pass it, we contribute $150 towards your equipment and backup power setup.

- This is a full-time, exclusive role. We do not mind what you do outside your contracted hours, but during them you are working for us and not for other clients. Please be straight with us about any existing commitments when you apply — we will not hold honesty against you.



We are looking for someone to be with us for years, not months.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read this carefully. We use it to see who pays attention.



1. Reply to this post with the subject line EXACTLY in this format:



   COMPASS - [your internet download speed in Mbps]



   For example:   COMPASS - 85



2. In your message, answer this one question in no more than five sentences:



   Tell us about something you organised or fixed — at work or in your own life — that nobody asked you to. What was it, and what made you do it?



Applications that do not follow both steps will not be opened. That is not us being difficult; attention to detail is most of this job, and this is the cheapest way for us to see it.



Everyone who follows the instructions will hear back from us either way. If we take you forward, the next step is a short application form, and after that a paid task — we pay for your time from that point on.



Thank you for reading all of it.
