title: Creative Strategist | Fast-Growing DTC Wellness Brand | Paid Social
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC wellness brand spending 7 figures/month on paid social. This is not a casual post. We have a structured hiring process, a real team, and a pipeline ready for the right person to step into. If you're serious about direct response and want to work directly with a founder who's building something real, keep reading.



We're open to both junior and senior strategists. If you're junior but hungry, you will learn more here in 6 months than most people learn in 3 years. If you're senior, you'll have full creative ownership and a team ready to execute your vision.



We need a Creative Strategist to own every ad concept we produce. You write the hooks, scripts, and briefs. Editors and designers execute your copy. Every ad the team produces starts with you.



What you do:



Write high-converting hooks, scripts, and leads for video ads. Monitor Meta Ad Library and TikTok to identify structural patterns behind what performs. Generate concepts mapped to audience awareness level and market sophistication. Translate scripts into briefs editors can execute without questions. Take learnings from media buyers on what's performing and use that data to inform new concepts. Produce variations of winners alongside new concepts. Manage the full pipeline in ClickUp.



What you need:



Direct-response script writing experience. Fluency in awareness levels, market sophistication, and hook/lead/mechanism/proof/offer architecture. Strong point of view on what makes ads work or fail. Ability to spot patterns across ads and turn them into original concepts. High volume output without quality dropping. Self-directed.



Nice to have:



Meta/TikTok ad platform knowledge. ClickUp experience. DTC or e-commerce background. LLM familiarity.



Compensation:



Paid trial to start. Base salary based on your experience and ask, plus uncapped performance bonuses tied to every winning ad you produce. There is no ceiling on what you can earn here.



Apply here: 



Please fill it out if you're serious. This is how we screen candidates. We're looking for real people, not mass applicants.

title: Recruitment & Team Building Specialist
description:
ABOUT BEES MOBILE



Bees Mobile is a digital communications company providing US/HK virtual phone numbers and travel eSIM services.



We are now expanding in the Philippines and looking for team members who can help us recruit, train, and grow our local Partner Network.



This is a long-term opportunity, starting with a short paid trial.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your main job is to find and recruit people who can become Bees Mobile Partners and Team Leaders, then help them get started and grow their teams.



Your responsibilities include:



Recruit Partners and potential Team Leaders across the Philippines

Reach out through
, Messenger, online communities, and your own network

Conduct online presentations through Zoom, Messenger, or similar platforms

Onboard and train new Partners using materials provided by the company

Follow up with Partners and help keep them active

Track recruitment results and submit a simple weekly report

Share feedback with our Marketing Team about what works in the Philippine market



Experience in Recruitment, Sales, Direct Selling, Network Marketing, Insurance, Reseller Networks, VA Management, or Team Leadership is a strong advantage.



2-WEEK PAID TRIAL



Candidates who pass our screening process will start with a 2-week paid trial.



10 working days

USD 20 per working day

USD 200 total for 10 completed working days

Clear targets and instructions will be provided before starting

Training materials, scripts, and presentation materials will be provided



During the trial, we will evaluate your recruitment performance, English communication, follow-up, execution, and ability to build a team.



IMPORTANT:



If you do not meet the required target during the 2-week trial, you will still be paid USD 20 for each completed working day, provided the required work for those days was properly completed.



ENGLISH COMMUNICATION IS IMPORTANT



This position requires communication with our Head Office and participation in online meetings and presentations.



You must be able to:



Speak and write English confidently

Understand English work instructions

Participate in meetings in English

Clearly explain Bees Mobile to potential Partners



A perfect accent is not required, but you must be comfortable communicating in English.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who:



Has experience in recruitment, sales, team building, direct selling, network marketing, insurance, reseller networks, or similar work

Has experience recruiting, training, or managing people

Has good spoken and written English

Is fluent in Tagalog

Can work independently and follow up consistently

Has stable internet and a quiet place for calls and meetings

Is comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools

Is organized, responsible, and honest about work progress



Bonus: Experience building large teams,
/Messenger recruiting, or an existing network in VA, OFW, travel, insurance, or direct-selling communities.



CAREER PATH & COMPENSATION



Stage 1 — 2-Week Paid Trial

USD 20/day × 10 working days = USD 200



Stage 2 — 3-Month Trial

USD 600–1,000/month + Performance Bonus



Stage 3 — Long-Term Position

Up to USD 1,300/month + Performance Bonus



Strong performers will have the opportunity to join Bees Mobile as long-term team members.



HOW TO APPLY

⚠️ A 2-MINUTE ENGLISH VIDEO IS REQUIRED.



Applications without the video will not be reviewed.



Please send:



1. Your CV or OnlineJobs Profile Link



2. A minimum 2-minute video introduction spoken entirely in English



Please answer:



Tell us about yourself and your work experience.

How many people have you recruited, trained, or managed?

Where would you find potential Partners or Team Leaders in the Philippines?

How would you start building a Partner Network?

Why are you interested in this role?



A simple phone recording is completely fine. We care about your English communication and what you say, not video production quality.



3. Start your application with the word “BEES.”



Applicants whose video passes the initial review will be invited to a short online interview.



Candidates who pass the interview will proceed to the 2-week paid trial.



Recruitment Process



Application + 2-Minute English Video → Short Online Interview → 2-Week Paid Trial → 3-Month Trial → Long-Term Position



Bees Mobile Hiring Team

title: Crypto BD Lead (Player-Coach)
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented.

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: VA for Digital Marketing & TikTok Shop Business
description:
Job Title: Part-Time TikTok Shop & Content Creator Virtual Assistant



PAY: $4 USD per hour

HOURS: 20 hours per week to start

SCHEDULE: Flexible, with a short daily check-in and dependable communication (I'm on Hawaii's time zone but flexible hours)

OPPORTUNITY: Potential for additional hours, full-time work based on performance, performance bonuses, and long-term employment



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a dependable, organized, and motivated Virtual Assistant to help operate and grow a TikTok Shop.



You will work with content creators and affiliates, help manage creator outreach, post and organize videos, perform basic video editing, and track the progress of our campaigns.



We use TikTok Shop, HourlyUGC, and other creator and marketing platforms. You will also be given access to a step-by-step training course from Affiliate Automations. You do not need to know everything on your first day, but you must be willing to complete the training, follow our process, and apply what you learn.



This is a good opportunity for someone who enjoys TikTok, social media, creator marketing, video content, and e-commerce.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



* Research and identify suitable TikTok creators and affiliates

* Contact creators using TikTok Shop, HourlyUGC,
, and other approved platforms

* Send outreach messages and follow up consistently

* Help review creator profiles, engagement, content quality, and previous sales performance

* Coordinate creator applications, product samples, deadlines, and deliverables

* Maintain positive and professional communication with creators

* Upload, schedule, organize, and correctly label short-form videos

* Perform basic video editing using CapCut, Canva, or similar software or ability to learn these quickly is great

* Add captions, hooks, text overlays, music, transitions, and calls to action

* Repurpose creator content into additional short-form videos

* Maintain creator and content tracking sheets in Google Sheets

* Track outreach, replies, samples, videos posted, views, sales, and other results

* Complete the Affiliate Automations training and follow our SOPs that we have video on for full training

* Provide a short end-of-day report showing completed tasks and current priorities

* Stay organized and follow through without needing constant reminders



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong Communication a plus

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Comfortable using TikTok and other social-media platforms

* Familiarity with Google Sheets 

* Excellent attention to detail

* Able to follow written and video instructions

* Organized and able to manage repetitive follow-up tasks

* Self-starter who can remain productive while working independently

* Dependable, honest, and responsive during agreed working hours

* Willing to learn new software and complete provided training



PREFERRED BUT NOT REQUIRED



* Experience with TikTok Shop Seller Center or Affiliate Center

* Experience with HourlyUGC or another creator-management platform

* Creator or influencer outreach experience

* CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, or other video-editing experience

* Digital marketing, affiliate marketing, social-media, or e-commerce experience

* Experience posting TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts

* Experience tracking content performance, sales, clicks, or conversions

* Basic understanding of hooks, retention, trends, and calls to action and social media frameworks



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



The right person will:



* Complete assigned tasks on time and be on
/dependable

* Keep creator records accurate and current

* Follow up consistently without being reminded

* Communicate early when something is unclear or delayed

* Learn our process and suggest sensible improvements

* Help increase the number of qualified creators contacted, samples delivered, videos posted, and sales generated



COMPENSATION



* Starting pay: $4 USD per hour

* Starting schedule: 20 hours per week

* Paid training

* Potential for additional hours and performance bonuses based on reliability and results

* Long-term opportunity for the right person



HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject line:



TikTok Shop VA – [Your First Name]



Include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with TikTok, creator outreach, digital marketing, e-commerce, or video editing or anything of this nature.

3. Which programs you have used, including TikTok Shop, HourlyUGC, CapCut, Canva, 
, Google Sheets, or similar tools.

4. Your normal working hours in Philippine time.

title: Shopify Store Builder and Creative Strategist
description:
About the role:



We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer Shopify brands. We build new stores, test products, and scale the winners with paid ads on Meta.



Your primary job is building Shopify stores. When we have a store in the queue, that's what you're working on, and we expect them built fast and built well. Between builds — and there will be real stretches between them — you shift to our second priority: static creative. Ad images that run on Meta, and on-site graphics that make our product pages look like real brands instead of dropshipping stores.



On the creative side, we want an owner, not a pair of hands. We'll give you the product, the market research, the customer angles, and examples of what's worked before. From there we expect you to do your own research into what's currently winning in the category, decide what's worth testing, and hand back finished creatives. If you need a detailed spec for every asset, this isn't the right role. If you already spend time in the Meta Ad Library because you find it interesting, keep reading.



So: a builder first, a designer second, and someone who can switch between the two without losing a day to context switching.



What you'll do:



Shopify store building (primary):



Build and launch new stores from a theme: home page, product pages, collection pages, policy pages, and the full navigation.

Install and configure apps (bundles, cart drawer, upsells, reviews,
) following our documented setup.

Set up product listings: variants, pricing, images, descriptions, SEO fields, and inventory settings.

Make sure every page looks correct on mobile first, then desktop. Most of our traffic is mobile.

Clone and adapt proven page layouts across new stores instead of reinventing each one. Speed comes from reuse.

Maintain live stores: fix broken sections, spacing problems, slow-loading images, misaligned buttons.

Keep our build process documented so each store goes faster than the last.



Static creative (between builds):



Design ad creatives for Meta in 1:1, 4:5, and 9:16 using our brand templates and safe-zone guidelines.

Research what's working right now in our categories: competitor ads, adjacent niches, ad libraries, TikTok and Instagram creative trends. Keep an organized swipe file we can all use.

Bring us new static concepts with a one-line rationale for each — new angles, new hooks, new formats.

Iterate on winners: when an ad performs, produce the variations that extend its life (new hook, new headline, new background, same winning structure).



Create on-site graphics: comparison charts, benefit icon rows, "how it works" strips, guarantee badges, review and testimonial cards, bundle graphics, size and spec charts.



Retouch and clean up supplier product photos — remove backgrounds, fix lighting, composite products into lifestyle scenes.

Organize every asset in our shared Drive with a consistent naming convention so we can trace which creative won.



Requirements:

Must have:



2+ years building Shopify stores. You know the theme editor cold and have shipped stores end to end, not just edited someone else's.

You're fast. Tell us honestly how long a full store build takes you from empty theme to launch-ready.

2+ years designing static ads for ecommerce — direct response, not brand or social content. You understand that an ad's job is to stop the scroll and sell, and your work shows it.

You can look at an ad and explain why it works: the angle, the hook, the visual hierarchy, the offer. We will ask you to do this in the interview.

A working habit of researching creative on your own — ad libraries, competitor tracking, saving what you see.

Fluent in Canva and at least one of Photoshop, Figma, or Illustrator.

You already use AI tools daily — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent — and you're good at it. We use AI throughout our operation: product research, ad copy, page copy, image generation and editing, troubleshooting Shopify issues, and speeding up repetitive work. We expect you to reach for these tools on your own, not wait to be told. Be ready to tell us specifically how you use them and where they save you time.

Solid written English. You'll be pitching creative ideas in writing, not just receiving instructions.

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle design work without crashing.

Genuinely self-directed. You plan your own week and report progress without being chased.



Nice to have:



Basic HTML/CSS for small theme tweaks.

Experience with page builders (GemPages, PageFly, Replo, Shogun).

Familiarity with conversion apps: bundle widgets, cart drawers, post-purchase upsells, review apps.

Experience running or managing Meta ads yourself, even at small scale.

Copywriting for ads — headlines, hooks, overlay text.

AI image generation and editing for creative work (Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Photoshop generative fill, or similar).

Basic video editing or motion (a plus, not required — we have a separate editor).



Tools you'll use:

Shopify, Canva, Photoshop or Figma, Claude and ChatGPT, AI image tools, Meta Ad Library, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack or WhatsApp, Loom, and a handful of Shopify apps we'll train you on.



What it's like working with us:

We give you the product, the research, and the goal — then get out of your way.

Fast feedback and no ambiguity about what "done" means.

We're direct. If something isn't working we'll tell you plainly, and we expect the same back. If you think one of our ideas is weak, say so.

Reliable pay, on schedule, every time.

Long-term role. If you're good, your scope and rate grow — we'd rather raise one strong person than cycle through five cheap ones.



How to apply:

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be read.



1. Put "BEESWAX" as the first word of your application so we know you read this.

2. Send a portfolio link with at least 3 Shopify stores you built (live URLs) and at least 5 static ads you designed for ecommerce brands. Tell us specifically what you did on each.



Answer these questions:

1. How long does a full store build take you, from empty theme to ready to launch? Walk us through your process briefly.

2. Go to the Meta Ad Library, pick any direct-to-consumer product you find interesting, and find one static ad you think is performing well. Send us the screenshot and 3–4 sentences on why you think it works.

3. Where do you look for creative inspiration and competitor research? Name the actual sources you use.

4. Which AI tools do you use in your day-to-day work, and give us one concrete example of a task you've made faster with them. Generic answers ("I use ChatGPT for content") tell us nothing.

5.Which are you stronger at — store building or creative? Be honest.

Tell us your hours in PHT, and your monthly rate for full-time work.



Shortlisted candidates get a small paid test project: build one product page from a reference, and — given a product and our market research — come back with three ad angles you'd test plus two finished statics. We pay for it whether or not we hire you.
